name: ACTIVE
description: Objects running a script or physically moving (using server resources). In llDetectedType(), it identifies physical objects and agents. In llSensor() or llSensorRepeat(), it searches for moving physical objects or scripted objects.

name: AGENT
description: Agents (avatars). In llDetectedType, it indicates an avatar. In llSensor or llSensorRepeat, it searches for avatars by legacy name (functionally identical to AGENT_BY_LEGACY_NAME, though using AGENT_BY_LEGACY_NAME is recommended instead).

name: AGENT_ALWAYS_RUN
description: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the queried avatar has 'Always Run' enabled or is using tap-tap-hold.

name: AGENT_ATTACHMENTS
description: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the queried avatar has attachments.

name: AGENT_AUTOMATED
description: Used with llGetAgentInfo to identify if the avatar is registered with Linden Lab as an automated/scripted agent (bot).

name: AGENT_AUTOPILOT
description: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the avatar is in autopilot mode, which is enabled when the user selects 'Go Here' on the ground or uses double-click autopilot.

name: AGENT_AWAY
description: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the avatar is in 'away' mode, which indicates they toggled away or have been inactive for too long.

name: AGENT_BUSY
description: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the avatar is in 'busy' mode.

name: AGENT_BY_LEGACY_NAME
description: Used to find agents by legacy name. In llDetectedType, it indicates an avatar. In llSensor or llSensorRepeat, it searches for avatars by legacy name.

name: AGENT_BY_USERNAME
description: Used to find agents by username (see Avatar Names).

name: AGENT_CROUCHING
description: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the avatar is crouching.

name: AGENT_FLOATING_VIA_SCRIPTED_ATTACHMENT
description: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the avatar is floating or hovering because of a scripted attachment using either llSetHoverHeight or llGroundRepel.

name: AGENT_FLYING
description: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the queried avatar is flying or hovering.

name: AGENT_IN_AIR
description: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the avatar is in the air (jumping, flying, or falling).

name: AGENT_LIST_PARCEL
description: Agents on the same parcel where the script is running.

name: AGENT_LIST_PARCEL_OWNER
description: Agents on any parcel in the region where the parcel owner is the same as the owner of the parcel under the scripted object.

name: AGENT_LIST_REGION
description: Returns any or all agents in the region.

name: AGENT_MOUSELOOK
description: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the avatar is in mouselook.

name: AGENT_ON_OBJECT
description: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the avatar is sitting on an object and linked to it.

name: AGENT_SCRIPTED
description: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the avatar is carrying scripted objects or has scripted attachments.

name: AGENT_SITTING
description: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the avatar is sitting.

name: AGENT_TYPING
description: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the avatar is typing.

name: AGENT_WALKING
description: Used with llGetAgentInfo to determine if the queried avatar is walking, running, or crouch walking.

name: ALL_SIDES
description: Selects all sides of an object in an applicable function.

name: ANIM_ON
description: Enables texture animation. This must be set to start the animation and cleared to stop it.

name: ATTACH_ANY_HUD
description: A special constant representing all HUD attachment points when filtering for any HUD attachment.

name: ATTACH_AVATAR_CENTER
description: Attachment point for the avatar's geometric center or root.

name: ATTACH_BACK
description: Attachment point for the avatar's back.

name: ATTACH_BELLY
description: Attachment point for the avatar's belly, stomach, or tummy.

name: ATTACH_CHEST
description: Attachment point for the avatar's chest or sternum.

name: ATTACH_CHIN
description: Attachment point for the avatar's chin.

name: ATTACH_FACE_JAW
description: Attachment point for the avatar's jaw.

name: ATTACH_FACE_LEAR
description: Attachment point for the avatar's left ear (extended).

name: ATTACH_FACE_LEYE
description: Attachment point for the avatar's left eye (extended).

name: ATTACH_FACE_REAR
description: Attachment point for the avatar's right ear (extended).

name: ATTACH_FACE_REYE
description: Attachment point for the avatar's right eye (extended).

name: ATTACH_FACE_TONGUE
description: Attachment point for the avatar's tongue.

name: ATTACH_GROIN
description: Attachment point for the avatar's groin.

name: ATTACH_HEAD
description: Attachment point for the avatar's head.

name: ATTACH_HIND_LFOOT
description: Attachment point for the avatar's left hind foot.

name: ATTACH_HIND_RFOOT
description: Attachment point for the avatar's right hind foot.

name: ATTACH_HUD_BOTTOM
description: Attachment point for HUD Bottom.

name: ATTACH_HUD_BOTTOM_LEFT
description: Attachment point for HUD Bottom Left.

name: ATTACH_HUD_BOTTOM_RIGHT
description: Attachment point for HUD Bottom Right.

name: ATTACH_HUD_CENTER_1
description: Attachment point for HUD Center.

name: ATTACH_HUD_CENTER_2
description: Attachment point for HUD Center 2.

name: ATTACH_HUD_TOP_CENTER
description: Attachment point for HUD Top Center.

name: ATTACH_HUD_TOP_LEFT
description: Attachment point for HUD Top Left.

name: ATTACH_HUD_TOP_RIGHT
description: Attachment point for HUD Top Right.

name: ATTACH_LEAR
description: Attachment point for the avatar's left ear.

name: ATTACH_LEFT_PEC
description: Attachment point for the avatar's left pectoral.

name: ATTACH_LEYE
description: Attachment point for the avatar's left eye.

name: ATTACH_LFOOT
description: Attachment point for the avatar's left foot.

name: ATTACH_LHAND
description: Attachment point for the avatar's left hand.

name: ATTACH_LHAND_RING1
description: Attachment point for the avatar's left ring finger.

name: ATTACH_LHIP
description: Attachment point for the avatar's left hip.

name: ATTACH_LLARM
description: Attachment point for the avatar's left lower arm.

name: ATTACH_LLLEG
description: Attachment point for the avatar's left lower leg.

name: ATTACH_LPEC
description: Attachment point for the avatar's right pectoral (deprecated, use ATTACH_RIGHT_PEC).

name: ATTACH_LSHOULDER
description: Attachment point for the avatar's left shoulder.

name: ATTACH_LUARM
description: Attachment point for the avatar's left upper arm.

name: ATTACH_LULEG
description: Attachment point for the avatar's left upper leg.

name: ATTACH_LWING
description: Attachment point for the avatar's left wing.

name: ATTACH_MOUTH
description: Attachment point for the avatar's mouth.

name: ATTACH_NECK
description: Attachment point for the avatar's neck.

name: ATTACH_NOSE
description: Attachment point for the avatar's nose.

name: ATTACH_PELVIS
description: Attachment point for the avatar's pelvis.

name: ATTACH_REAR
description: Attachment point for the avatar's right ear.

name: ATTACH_REYE
description: Attachment point for the avatar's right eye.

name: ATTACH_RFOOT
description: Attachment point for the avatar's right foot.

name: ATTACH_RHAND
description: Attachment point for the avatar's right hand (the default attachment point).

name: ATTACH_RHAND_RING1
description: Attachment point for the avatar's right ring finger.

name: ATTACH_RHIP
description: Attachment point for the avatar's right hip.

name: ATTACH_RIGHT_PEC
description: Attachment point for the avatar's right pectoral.

name: ATTACH_RLARM
description: Attachment point for the avatar's right lower arm.

name: ATTACH_RLLEG
description: Attachment point for the avatar's right lower leg.

name: ATTACH_RPEC
description: Attachment point for the avatar's left pectoral (deprecated, use ATTACH_LEFT_PEC).

name: ATTACH_RSHOULDER
description: Attachment point for the avatar's right shoulder.

name: ATTACH_RUARM
description: Attachment point for the avatar's right upper arm.

name: ATTACH_RULEG
description: Attachment point for the avatar's right upper leg.

name: ATTACH_RWING
description: Attachment point for the avatar's right wing.

name: ATTACH_TAIL_BASE
description: Attachment point for the avatar's tail base.

name: ATTACH_TAIL_TIP
description: Attachment point for the avatar's tail tip.

name: BEACON_MAP
description: Causes llMapBeacon to optionally display and focus the world map on the avatar's viewer.

name: CAMERA_ACTIVE
description: Option flag used with llSetCameraParams to turn scripted control of the camera on or off.

name: CAMERA_BEHINDNESS_ANGLE
description: Sets the angle in degrees within which the camera is not constrained by changes in target rotation.

name: CAMERA_BEHINDNESS_LAG
description: Sets how strongly the camera is forced to stay behind the target if outside of the behindness angle.

name: CAMERA_DISTANCE
description: Sets how far away the camera wants to be from its target.

name: CAMERA_FOCUS
description: Sets camera focus (target position) in region coordinates.

name: CAMERA_FOCUS_LAG
description: Sets how much the camera lags as it aims toward the target.

name: CAMERA_FOCUS_LOCKED
description: Option flag used with llSetCameraParams to lock the camera focus so it does not move.

name: CAMERA_FOCUS_OFFSET
description: Adjusts the camera focus position relative to the target.

name: CAMERA_FOCUS_THRESHOLD
description: Sets the radius of a sphere around the camera's target position within which its focus is not affected by target motion.

name: CAMERA_PITCH
description: Adjusts the angular amount that the camera aims straight ahead versus straight down, maintaining the same distance (analogous to 'incidence').

name: CAMERA_POSITION
description: Sets camera position in region coordinates.

name: CAMERA_POSITION_LAG
description: Sets how much the camera lags as it moves toward its ideal position.

name: CAMERA_POSITION_LOCKED
description: Option flag used with llSetCameraParams to lock the camera position so it does not move.

name: CAMERA_POSITION_THRESHOLD
description: Sets the radius of a sphere around the camera's ideal position within which it is not affected by target motion.

name: CHANGED_ALLOWED_DROP
description: Object inventory changed because a user other than the owner (or the owner if the object is no-mod) added an item. This is only possible if enabled via llAllowInventoryDrop.

name: CHANGED_COLOR
description: Object's Blinn-Phong color or alpha parameters have changed.

name: CHANGED_INVENTORY
description: Prim inventory has changed by someone who has modification rights to it.

name: CHANGED_LINK
description: Number of prims making up the object or avatars seated on it has changed. Also occurs when duplicating a linked object or when a prim changes type or shape. Does not trigger on attach/detach, sit/unsit in attachments, or single prim duplication.

name: CHANGED_MEDIA
description: Prim Media on the prim has changed.

name: CHANGED_OWNER
description: Object has changed owners. Triggers in the original object when a user takes it, copies it, or deeds it to a group, and in the new object when it is first rezzed.

name: CHANGED_REGION
description: Object has changed regions by crossing a boundary or teleporting (if attached). Triggers only in the root prim of a linkset.

name: CHANGED_REGION_START
description: Region containing this object has just come online.

name: CHANGED_RENDER_MATERIAL
description: Render material (prim material ID or material overrides) has changed on one or more faces.

name: CHANGED_SCALE
description: Prim scale of at least one prim in the linked object has changed. Only the root prim receives this event.

name: CHANGED_SHAPE
description: Prim base shape (PRIM_TYPE, such as box, prism, torus, taper, twist, or cut) has changed.

name: CHANGED_TELEPORT
description: Avatar this object is attached to has teleported. Triggers only in the root prim of an attachment. Does not occur for child prims or 'sit teleports'. If scripts are disabled at the destination, the event queues and triggers after moving to a script-enabled parcel.

name: CHANGED_TEXTURE
description: Prim texture parameters (shine/bump settings, repeats, flip, rotation, offset, or texture) have changed.

name: CHARACTER_ACCOUNT_FOR_SKIPPED_FRAMES
description: If set to FALSE, the pathfinding character will not attempt to catch up on lost time when performance is low, potentially providing more reliable (though potentially more stuttery) movement. Default is TRUE.

name: CHARACTER_AVOIDANCE_MODE
description: Specifies which objects a pathfinding character avoids (other characters, dynamic obstacles like fast-moving objects and avatars, or both). Combined using bit flags; setting to AVOID_NONE disables avoidance for both categories.

name: CHARACTER_CMD_JUMP
description: Makes the character jump. Requires a height parameter between 0.1m and 2.0m as the first element of the llExecCharacterCmd option list.

name: CHARACTER_CMD_SMOOTH_STOP
description: Stops any current pathfinding operation in a smooth fashion.

name: CHARACTER_CMD_STOP
description: Stops any current pathfinding operation.

name: CHARACTER_DESIRED_SPEED
description: Constant used to indicate that the following argument is the desired speed (or speed of pursuit in meters per second) for a pathfinding character.

name: CHARACTER_DESIRED_TURN_SPEED
description: Specifies the character's maximum speed while turning about the Z-axis (default is 6 meters/second). Note that this is only loosely enforced, and a character may turn at higher speeds under certain conditions.

name: CHARACTER_LENGTH
description: Sets the collision capsule length for a pathfinding character. If the value is less than twice the radius plus 0.1m, it automatically adjusts to twice the radius plus 0.1m.

name: CHARACTER_MAX_ACCEL
description: Specifies the character's maximum acceleration rate (default is 20 m/s²).

name: CHARACTER_MAX_DECEL
description: Specifies the character's maximum deceleration rate (default is 30 m/s²).

name: CHARACTER_MAX_SPEED
description: Specifies the character's maximum speed (must be between 0.2 and 50 meters/second; default is 20 m/s). Affects speed when avoiding dynamic obstacles and when traversing low-walkability objects in TRAVERSAL_TYPE_FAST mode.

name: CHARACTER_MAX_TURN_RADIUS
description: Specifies the character's turn radius when traveling at CHARACTER_DESIRED_TURN_SPEED (default is 1.25 meters).

name: CHARACTER_ORIENTATION
description: Specifies the orientation of the collision capsule for a pathfinding character to denote how to interpret its size. Valid options are VERTICAL and HORIZONTAL.

name: CHARACTER_RADIUS
description: Sets the collision capsule radius used to define the size of a pathfinding character.

name: CHARACTER_STAY_WITHIN_PARCEL
description: Determines whether a character is restricted to its starting parcel (default is FALSE). If TRUE, parcel boundaries act as one-way obstacles; the character cannot voluntarily leave and pathfinding behaviors (wander, flee, evade, pursue) will only choose goal points within the parcel. If pushed out, it can re-enter but cannot voluntarily leave again.

name: CHARACTER_TYPE
description: Specifies the preferred surface and terrain terrain-type for the character (default is CHARACTER_TYPE_NONE). Used to describe preferred surfaces rather than behavior (e.g., cows prefer type B, sheep herded along a road prefer type C).

name: CHARACTER_TYPE_A
description: Used for pathfinding character types that prefer movement consistent with humanoids.

name: CHARACTER_TYPE_B
description: Used for pathfinding character types that prefer movement consistent with wild animals or off-road vehicles.

name: CHARACTER_TYPE_C
description: Used for mechanical pathfinding character types or road-going vehicles.

name: CHARACTER_TYPE_D
description: Used for pathfinding character types that are inconsistent with types A, B, or C.

name: CHARACTER_TYPE_NONE
description: Used to set no specific pathfinding character type.

name: CLICK_ACTION_BUY
description: Opens the buy dialog when the prim is clicked or touched.

name: CLICK_ACTION_DISABLED
description: Disables click actions. No touches are detected or passed.

name: CLICK_ACTION_IGNORE
description: Disables click actions. Clicks pass through the object to whatever is behind it, and no touches are detected.

name: CLICK_ACTION_NONE
description: Performs the default action: triggers touch events when the prim is clicked or touched.

name: CLICK_ACTION_OPEN
description: Opens the object inventory dialog when the prim is clicked or touched.

name: CLICK_ACTION_OPEN_MEDIA
description: Opens the web media dialog or plays parcel media (without pausing) when the prim is touched.

name: CLICK_ACTION_PAY
description: Opens the pay dialog when the prim is clicked or touched.

name: CLICK_ACTION_PLAY
description: Enables HTML-on-a-prim or plays/pauses parcel media when the prim is clicked or touched.

name: CLICK_ACTION_SIT
description: Causes the avatar to sit on the prim when it is clicked or touched.

name: CLICK_ACTION_TOUCH
description: Triggers touch events when the prim is clicked or touched.

name: CLICK_ACTION_ZOOM
description: Zooms the avatar camera in on the object (Viewer 2) when clicked or touched.

name: COMBAT_CHANNEL
description: A region-wide channel reserved for combat-related log events. Passing this to llRegionSay adds the message to the combat log, and scripts listening on this channel can monitor the combat log.

name: COMBAT_LOG_ID
description: ID used by all combat log messages sent from the region to the COMBAT_CHANNEL. Scripts can filter llListen calls with this ID to receive only system-generated combat log messages.

name: CONTENT_TYPE_ATOM
description: Sets the 'Content-Type' header of subsequent LSL HTTP server responses via llHTTPResponse to 'application/atom+xml'.

name: CONTENT_TYPE_FORM
description: Sets the 'Content-Type' header of subsequent LSL HTTP server responses via llHTTPResponse to 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'.

name: CONTENT_TYPE_HTML
description: Sets the 'Content-Type' header of subsequent LSL HTTP server responses via llHTTPResponse to 'text/html'. Only valid for embedded browsers on content owned by the viewer; falls back to 'text/plain' otherwise.

name: CONTENT_TYPE_JSON
description: Sets the 'Content-Type' header of subsequent LSL HTTP server responses via llHTTPResponse to 'application/json'.

name: CONTENT_TYPE_LLSD
description: Sets the 'Content-Type' header of subsequent LSL HTTP server responses via llHTTPResponse to 'application/llsd+xml' (Linden Lab Structured Data).

name: CONTENT_TYPE_RSS
description: Sets the 'Content-Type' header of subsequent LSL HTTP server responses via llHTTPResponse to 'application/rss+xml'.

name: CONTENT_TYPE_TEXT
description: Sets the 'Content-Type' header of subsequent LSL HTTP server responses via llHTTPResponse to 'text/plain'.

name: CONTENT_TYPE_XHTML
description: Sets the 'Content-Type' header of subsequent LSL HTTP server responses via llHTTPResponse to 'application/xhtml+xml'.

name: CONTENT_TYPE_XML
description: Sets the 'Content-Type' header of subsequent LSL HTTP server responses via llHTTPResponse to 'application/xml'.

name: CONTROL_BACK
description: Tests for the avatar move back control (↓ or S).

name: CONTROL_DOWN
description: Tests for the avatar move down control (PgDn or C).

name: CONTROL_FWD
description: Tests for the avatar move forward control (↑ or W).

name: CONTROL_LBUTTON
description: Tests for the avatar left mouse button control.

name: CONTROL_LEFT
description: Tests for the avatar move left control (Shift + ← or Shift + A).

name: CONTROL_ML_LBUTTON
description: Tests for the avatar left mouse button control while in mouselook.

name: CONTROL_RIGHT
description: Tests for the avatar move right control (Shift + → or Shift + D).

name: CONTROL_ROT_LEFT
description: Tests for the avatar rotate left control (← or A).

name: CONTROL_ROT_RIGHT
description: Tests for the avatar rotate right control (→ or D).

name: CONTROL_UP
description: Tests for the avatar move up control (PgUp or E).

name: DAMAGEABLE
description: Identifies objects in the world that can process damage. In llDetectedType, it indicates a damageable agent, or an object containing a script with on_damage or final_damage events. Can also filter llSensor/llSensorRepeat calls.

name: DAMAGE_TYPE_ACID
description: Damage caused by a caustic substance, such as acid.

name: DAMAGE_TYPE_BLUDGEONING
description: Damage caused by a blunt object, such as a club.

name: DAMAGE_TYPE_COLD
description: Damage inflicted by exposure to extreme cold.

name: DAMAGE_TYPE_ELECTRIC
description: Damage caused by electricity.

name: DAMAGE_TYPE_FIRE
description: Damage inflicted by exposure to heat or flames.

name: DAMAGE_TYPE_FORCE
description: Damage inflicted by a great force or impact (Vertical Sim / SLMC).

name: DAMAGE_TYPE_GENERIC
description: Generic or legacy damage.

name: DAMAGE_TYPE_IMPACT
description: System damage generated by impact with land, terrain, or a prim.

name: DAMAGE_TYPE_NECROTIC
description: Damage caused by a direct assault on the life-force.

name: DAMAGE_TYPE_PIERCING
description: Damage caused by a piercing object such as a bullet, spear, or arrow (Vertical Sim / SLMC).

name: DAMAGE_TYPE_POISON
description: Damage caused by poison.

name: DAMAGE_TYPE_PSYCHIC
description: Damage caused by a direct assault on the mind.

name: DAMAGE_TYPE_RADIANT
description: Damage caused by radiation or extreme light.

name: DAMAGE_TYPE_SLASHING
description: Damage caused by a slashing object such as a sword or axe.

name: DAMAGE_TYPE_SONIC
description: Damage caused by loud noises, like a Crash Worship concert.

name: DATA_BORN
description: Used with llRequestAgentData to return the agent's account creation ('born on') date as a string in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD), based on Pacific Time (not UTC).

name: DATA_NAME
description: Used with llRequestAgentData to return the requested agent's legacy name.

name: DATA_ONLINE
description: Used with llRequestAgentData to return whether the requested agent is online (returns an integer boolean string: TRUE if online, FALSE if offline).

name: DATA_PAYINFO
description: Used with llRequestAgentData to return a string containing the integer mask flag for payment status (contains PAYMENT_INFO_ON_FILE, PAYMENT_INFO_USED, or both).

name: DATA_RATING
description: Deprecated. Used with llRequestAgentData to return the string '0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0'. It formerly returned a comma-separated list of positive and negative ratings (behavior, appearance, and building) before ratings were removed from SL.

name: DATA_RESERVED_0
description: Reserved for Linden use.

name: DATA_SIM_POS
description: Used with llRequestSimulatorData to return the region's global position as a vector.

name: DATA_SIM_RATING
description: Used with llRequestSimulatorData to return the simulator rating string ('PG', 'MATURE', 'ADULT', or 'UNKNOWN').

name: DATA_SIM_STATUS
description: Used with llRequestSimulatorData to return the simulator status as a string.

name: DEBUG_CHANNEL
description: A chat channel reserved for script debugging and error messages. Passing this to llSay, llWhisper, or llShout prints text to the Script Warning/Error Window and broadcasts it to nearby avatars' script consoles.

name: DEG_TO_RAD
description: Constant 0.017453293 (precise value is PI/180). Multiply a value in degrees by this number to convert it to radians.

name: DENSITY
description: Used with llSetPhysicsMaterial to indicate that the density parameter is enabled (which overrides the previous value). Must be between 1.0 and 22587.0 kg/m³.

name: DEREZ_DIE
description: Used with llDerezObject to immediately delete (kill) the object.

name: DEREZ_MAKE_TEMP
description: Used with llDerezObject to mark the object as temporary, allowing the simulator to clean it up at a later time.

name: DEREZ_TO_INVENTORY
description: Used with llDerezObject to return the targeted object to the rezzer's (derezzer's) inventory, saving its current state.

name: ENVIRONMENT_DAYINFO
description: Day cycle and time information: day_length (seconds in the environment's day cycle), day_offset (seconds offset from GMT), and secs_since_midnight (seconds elapsed since the last day cycle midnight).

name: ENV_INVALID_AGENT
description: Unable to find the specified agent, or could not find an agent with the specified ID.

name: ENV_INVALID_RULE
description: There was an issue with one of the rules, or an attempt was made to change an unknown property.

name: ENV_NOT_EXPERIENCE
description: Attempted to change environments outside an experience, or the script is not running as part of an experience with a valid experience key.

name: ENV_NO_ENVIRONMENT
description: Environmental settings inventory object could not be found, or there is no environment on this parcel to modify.

name: ENV_NO_EXPERIENCE_LAND
description: Experience has not been enabled or cannot run on the land.

name: ENV_NO_EXPERIENCE_PERMISSION
description: Agent has not granted permission to change environments.

name: ENV_NO_PERMISSIONS
description: Script lacks permissions to modify the environment at this location, or an attempt was made to remove altitude track 0 or 1.

name: ENV_OK
description: Agent, parcel, or region will attempt to change the applied environment.

name: ENV_THROTTLE
description: Scripts have exceeded the throttle limit. Wait and retry the request.

name: ENV_VALIDATION_FAIL
description: Could not validate the environmental settings or values passed.

name: EOF
description:
Value returned by llGetNotecardLine (through the dataserver event) and llGetNotecardLineSync when the requested line is past the end of the notecard. Equal to three newline characters ("


").

name: ERR_GENERIC
description: An inexplicable and generic error where nothing is known about the cause.

name: ERR_MALFORMED_PARAMS
description: Return value for llReturnObject* functions indicating that the parameters passed are malformed.

name: ERR_PARCEL_PERMISSIONS
description: Return value for llReturnObject* functions indicating a lack of permissions to perform the task on the specified parcel.

name: ERR_RUNTIME_PERMISSIONS
description: Return value for llReturnObject* functions indicating the script lacks the runtime permissions required to perform the requested task.

name: ERR_THROTTLED
description: Return value for llReturnObject* functions indicating that the task has been throttled and should be retried later.

name: ESTATE_ACCESS_ALLOWED_AGENT_ADD
description: Used as an input parameter for llManageEstateAccess to add an agent to the estate's Allowed Residents list.

name: ESTATE_ACCESS_ALLOWED_AGENT_REMOVE
description: Used as an input parameter for llManageEstateAccess to remove an agent from the estate's Allowed Residents list.

name: ESTATE_ACCESS_ALLOWED_GROUP_ADD
description: Used as an input parameter for llManageEstateAccess to add a group to the estate's Allowed Groups list.

name: ESTATE_ACCESS_ALLOWED_GROUP_REMOVE
description: Used as an input parameter for llManageEstateAccess to remove a group from the estate's Allowed Groups list.

name: ESTATE_ACCESS_BANNED_AGENT_ADD
description: Used as an input parameter for llManageEstateAccess to add an agent to the estate's Banned Residents list.

name: ESTATE_ACCESS_BANNED_AGENT_REMOVE
description: Used as an input parameter for llManageEstateAccess to remove an agent from the estate's Banned Residents list.

name: FALSE
description: Constant representing a boolean FALSE value. Used in conditional structures or variables to improve readability over the integer value (0).

name: FILTER_FLAGS
description: Flags used to control which attachments are returned.

name: FILTER_FLAG_HUDS
description: Filter flag used with llGetAttachedListFiltered to include HUDs with matching experiences in the returned result.

name: FILTER_INCLUDE
description: Filter parameter used to include a specific attachment point.

name: FORCE_DIRECT_PATH
description: Forces the pathfinding character to navigate in a straight line toward the specified position (can be set to TRUE or FALSE).

name: FRICTION
description: Used with llSetPhysicsMaterial to enable the friction override. The value must be between 0.0 and 255.0.

name: GAME_CONTROL_AXIS_ADVANCE
description: Forward/backward movement. Modal axis index 1 for AVATAR, MOUSELOOK, and CAPTIVE modes.

name: GAME_CONTROL_AXIS_BOOM
description: Camera up/down movement. Modal axis index 4 for FLYCAM mode.

name: GAME_CONTROL_AXIS_DOLLY
description: Camera forward/backward movement. Modal axis index 1 for FLYCAM mode.

name: GAME_CONTROL_AXIS_LEFTX
description: Left stick X axis. Canonical axis index 0.

name: GAME_CONTROL_AXIS_LEFTY
description: Left stick Y axis. Canonical axis index 1.

name: GAME_CONTROL_AXIS_LEFT_TRIGGER
description: Left trigger. Canonical axis index 4.

name: GAME_CONTROL_AXIS_LOOK
description: Looking up/down. Modal axis index 3 for AVATAR, MOUSELOOK, CAPTIVE, and CURSOR modes.

name: GAME_CONTROL_AXIS_PAN
description: Camera pan left/right. Modal axis index 2 for FLYCAM mode.

name: GAME_CONTROL_AXIS_RIGHTX
description: Right stick X axis. Canonical axis index 2.

name: GAME_CONTROL_AXIS_RIGHTY
description: Right stick Y axis. Canonical axis index 3.

name: GAME_CONTROL_AXIS_RIGHT_TRIGGER

description: Used with llGetClosestNavPoint to limit how far out to search for a navigation point.

name: GCNP_STATIC
description: Used with llGetClosestNavPoint to specify that the test should use the static navmesh, ignoring all dynamic obstacles.

name: GRAVITY_MULTIPLIER
description: Used with llSetPhysicsMaterial to enable the gravity multiplier override. The value must be between -1.0 and +28.0.

name: HORIZONTAL
description: Constant indicating that the collision capsule orientation for a pathfinding character is horizontal.

name: HTTP_ACCEPT
description: Used with llHTTPRequest to override the default Accept header with custom MIME types (such as application/json, text/html, etc.). Responses with unlisted content types will return status 415.

name: HTTP_BODY_MAXLENGTH
description: Sets the maximum (UTF-8 encoded) byte length of the HTTP response body. The maximum limit depends on the VM being used (Mono Max: 16384 bytes, LSO Max: 4096 bytes).

name: HTTP_BODY_TRUNCATED
description: Indicates the response body truncation point in bytes.

name: HTTP_CUSTOM_HEADER
description: Adds custom HTTP headers to the request (up to 8 per request). At the SLua level, provide a string-keyed table mapping header names to values; the serializer emits one HTTP_CUSTOM_HEADER/key/value triple per entry. Some default or sensitive headers are blocked for security reasons.

name: HTTP_EXTENDED_ERROR
description: If set to TRUE, llHTTPRequest always returns a key. If an error occurs during the request, detailed error information (delivered in an RFC 7807 JSON block) is reported through the http_response event using that key.

name: HTTP_METHOD
description: Specifies the HTTP method ('GET', 'POST', 'PUT', or 'DELETE') for the request.

name: HTTP_MIMETYPE
description: Specifies the request Content-Type MIME type. Text types should define a charset (e.g., 'text/plain;charset=utf-8'). Use 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' to emulate HTML forms.

name: HTTP_PRAGMA_NO_CACHE
description: Controls whether the 'Pragma: no-cache' header is sent with the HTTP request. When SendHeader is TRUE (default), the header is sent; when FALSE, it is omitted.

name: HTTP_USER_AGENT
description: Appends a custom string to the default LSL User-Agent header value. Must follow HTTP standard syntax (e.g., 'My-Script-Name/1.0'). Spaces are not allowed and will cause a script error; use hyphens instead.

name: HTTP_VERBOSE_THROTTLE
description: If set to TRUE, shouts error messages to DEBUG_CHANNEL if the outgoing request rate exceeds the server limit. If FALSE, these error messages are suppressed.

name: HTTP_VERIFY_CERT
description: If set to TRUE, the server's SSL certificate must be verifiable using a standard certificate authority when making HTTPS requests. If FALSE, any SSL certificate is accepted.

name: JSON_APPEND
description: A specifier for llJsonSetValue indicating the given value should be appended to the array at the specified level. If the target value is not an array, the existing data will be overwritten and replaced by the new array.

name: JSON_ARRAY
description: Used with llList2Json to indicate that the provided list should be encoded and returned as a string-serialized JSON array.

name: JSON_DELETE
description: A constant used to delete a value within a JSON text string.

name: JSON_FALSE
description: Return value for llJsonValueType indicating that the value at the specified address in a JSON string is a boolean FALSE.

name: JSON_INVALID
description: Indicates an invalid state or parameter. Returned by llList2Json when inputs are not well-formed, by llJsonValueType for an invalid JSON type, or by llJsonGetValue when attempting to access a nonexistent location.

name: JSON_NULL
description: Return value for llJsonValueType indicating that the value at the specified address in a JSON string is a JSON null.

name: JSON_NUMBER
description: Return value for llJsonValueType indicating that the value at the specified address in a JSON string is a number.

name: JSON_OBJECT
description: Used with llList2Json to indicate that the provided list is a strided list of key-value pairs to be encoded and returned as a JSON object.

name: JSON_STRING
description: Return value for llJsonValueType indicating that the value at the specified address in a JSON string is a string.

name: JSON_TRUE
description: Return value for llJsonValueType indicating that the value at the specified address in a JSON string is a boolean TRUE.

name: KFM_CMD_PAUSE
description: Command used with KFM_COMMAND in llSetKeyframedMotion to pause the keyframed motion without resetting it to the start.

name: KFM_CMD_PLAY
description: Command used with KFM_COMMAND in llSetKeyframedMotion to resume a motion previously stopped by KFM_CMD_STOP or paused by KFM_CMD_PAUSE.

name: KFM_CMD_STOP
description: Command used with KFM_COMMAND in llSetKeyframedMotion to stop the keyframed motion and reset it to the start.

name: KFM_COMMAND
description: Option flag in llSetKeyframedMotion followed by KFM_CMD_STOP, KFM_CMD_PLAY, or KFM_CMD_PAUSE to play, stop, or pause the motion.

name: KFM_DATA
description: Option flag in llSetKeyframedMotion followed by a bitwise combination of KFM_TRANSLATION and KFM_ROTATION to specify keyframe data. If absent, both rotation and translation data must be provided.

name: KFM_FORWARD
description: Playback mode used with KFM_MODE in llSetKeyframedMotion (default). It plays the frames sequentially from 1 to N and then stops.

name: KFM_LOOP
description: Playback mode used with KFM_MODE in llSetKeyframedMotion. It plays the frames sequentially from 1 to N, returns to the initial position, and repeats indefinitely.

name: KFM_MODE
description: Option flag in llSetKeyframedMotion followed by KFM_LOOP, KFM_REVERSE, KFM_FORWARD, or KFM_PING_PONG to set the playback mode (defaults to KFM_FORWARD). Must be specified when the keyframe list is provided.

name: KFM_PING_PONG
description: Playback mode used with KFM_MODE in llSetKeyframedMotion.

name: KFM_REVERSE
description: Playback mode used with KFM_MODE in llSetKeyframedMotion. It plays the frames in reverse order (from N down to 1) and then stops.

name: KFM_ROTATION
description: Specifies that rotation data is included in the moves list for llSetKeyframedMotion.

name: KFM_TRANSLATION
description: Specifies that translation data is included in the moves list for llSetKeyframedMotion.

name: LAND_NOISE

name: LAND_RAISE

name: LAND_REVERT

name: LAND_SMALL_BRUSH

name: LAND_SMOOTH
description: Action used with llModifyLand to smooth the land.

name: LINKSETDATA_DELETE
description: Action indicating a key was deleted from the linkset datastore via llLinksetDataDelete, llLinksetDataDeleteProtected, or by writing an empty value.

name: LINKSETDATA_EMEMORY
description: Error code indicating the key and value were too large to write to the linkset datastore.

name: LINKSETDATA_ENOKEY
description: Error code indicating the key name supplied to a linkset datastore operation was empty.

name: LINKSETDATA_EPROTECTED
description: Error code indicating the key is protected from being deleted or overwritten in the linkset datastore.

name: LINKSETDATA_MULTIDELETE
description: Action indicating keys were deleted from the linkset datastore via llLinksetDataDeleteFound. The event's name is a comma-separated list of the deleted keys.

name: LINKSETDATA_NOTFOUND
description: Error code indicating the specified key could not be found in the linkset datastore.

name: LINKSETDATA_NOUPDATE
description: Status code indicating that the linkset datastore was not updated because the written value matched the existing stored value.

name: LINKSETDATA_OK
description: Status code indicating the linkset datastore operation completed successfully.

name: LINKSETDATA_RESET
description: Action indicating all keys were deleted from the linkset datastore via llLinksetDataReset.

name: LINKSETDATA_UPDATE
description: Action indicating a key was created or updated in the linkset datastore via llLinksetDataWrite or llLinksetDataWriteProtected.

name: LINK_ALL_CHILDREN
description: Refers to all child prims in the linkset (every prim except the root).

name: LINK_ALL_OTHERS
description: Refers to every other prim in the linkset, excluding the prim containing the script.

name: LINK_ROOT
description: Refers to the root prim of the linkset.

name: LINK_SET
description: Refers to every prim in the linkset.

name: LINK_THIS
description: Refers specifically to the single prim containing the running script.

name: LIST_STAT_GEOMETRIC_MEAN
description: Option used with llListStatistics to calculate the geometric mean of a list of numbers.

name: LIST_STAT_MAX
description: Option used with llListStatistics to find the largest number in the list.

name: LIST_STAT_MEAN
description: Option used with llListStatistics to calculate the mean (average) of the numbers in the list.

name: LIST_STAT_MEDIAN
description: Option used with llListStatistics to calculate the median of the numbers in the list.

name: LIST_STAT_MIN
description: Option used with llListStatistics to find the smallest number in the list.

name: LIST_STAT_NUM_COUNT
description: Option used with llListStatistics to determine the count of float and integer elements in the list.

name: LIST_STAT_RANGE
description: Option used with llListStatistics to calculate the range (maximum value minus minimum value) of the list.

name: LIST_STAT_STD_DEV
description: Option used with llListStatistics to calculate the sample standard deviation of a list of numbers.

name: LIST_STAT_SUM
description: Option used with llListStatistics to calculate the sum of the numbers in the list.

name: LIST_STAT_SUM_SQUARES
description: Option used with llListStatistics to calculate the sum of the squares of the numbers in the list.

name: LOOP
description: Used with texture animation functions to cause the animation to loop continuously.

name: MASK_BASE
description: Permissions mask option representing base permissions.

name: MASK_COMBINED
description: Permissions mask option to include the object's inventory contents when calculating permissions. Can be combined with other mask flags (e.g., MASK_OWNER | MASK_COMBINED).

name: MASK_EVERYONE
description: Permissions mask option representing permissions held by everyone.

name: MASK_GROUP
description: Permissions mask option representing active group permissions.

name: MASK_NEXT
description: Permissions mask option representing permissions the next owner will inherit.

name: MASK_OWNER
description: Permissions mask option representing current owner permissions.

description: Value returned by llGetNotecardLineSync and llFindNotecardTextSync (as a single-entry list) when the notecard is not in the region's cache. Equal to an ASCII NAK surrounded by newlines (codes 10, 21, 10).

name: NULL_KEY
description: A special string constant used as a null or empty key value.

name: OBJECT_ACCOUNT_LEVEL
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to retrieve an avatar's account level. Returns 0 for Basic, 1 for Premium, 5 for Plus, 10 for Premium Plus, or -1 if the target is not an avatar.

name: OBJECT_ANIMATED_COUNT
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails. For an object, returns a boolean indicating if the root is set as 'Animated Mesh'. For an agent, returns the total number of 'Animated Mesh' attachments worn.

name: OBJECT_ANIMATED_SLOTS_AVAILABLE
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the avatar's available 'Animated Mesh' attachment slot count (returns 0 if the ID is not an avatar).

name: OBJECT_ATTACHED_POINT
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails. Returns the integer attachment point matching an ATTACH_* constant, or 0 if the target is not an attachment (e.g., an avatar or unattached object).

name: OBJECT_ATTACHED_SLOTS_AVAILABLE
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get an avatar's available attachment slot count. Returns 0 if the ID is not an avatar or if no slots are available.

name: OBJECT_BODY_SHAPE_TYPE
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to retrieve a float representing the gender/sex setting of an avatar's shape (0.0 is standard female, 1.0 is standard male, and values greater than or equal to 0.5 are considered male). Returns -1.0 if not an avatar or if no data is available.

name: OBJECT_CHARACTER_TIME
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the average CPU time (in seconds) spent on navigation if the target is a pathfinding character. Returns 0 for non-characters.

name: OBJECT_CLICK_ACTION
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the click action of a prim. Returns an integer corresponding to a CLICK_ACTION_* constant (default is 0).

name: OBJECT_CREATION_TIME
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the object's creation time (established via build-menu rezzing or mesh uploads, not via inventory/script rezzes, copying, or modifying). Returns an empty string for avatars.

name: OBJECT_CREATOR
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the key of the prim's creator. Returns NULL_KEY if the ID is an avatar.

name: OBJECT_DAMAGE
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to retrieve the amount of damage a prim inflicts upon collision.

name: OBJECT_DAMAGE_TYPE
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to retrieve the type of damage a prim inflicts on collision. Returns an integer matching a DAMAGE_TYPE_* constant, a custom type, or a value repurposed by a combat system.

name: OBJECT_DESC
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to retrieve the prim's description. Returns an empty string if the ID is an avatar.

name: OBJECT_GROUP
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the prim's group key. Returns NULL_KEY if the target is an avatar (which means a workaround is required to get an avatar's active group).

name: OBJECT_GROUP_TAG
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get an avatar's active group tag/title. Returns an empty string if the target is not an avatar.

name: OBJECT_HEALTH
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to retrieve the current health value of an avatar or prim.

name: OBJECT_HOVER_HEIGHT
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the dynamic hover height of an avatar (default is 0.0). Returns 0.0 if not an avatar or if no data is available; does not reflect the shape's 'Hover' slider.

name: OBJECT_LAST_OWNER_ID
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the key of the previous owner. For group-owned objects, returns the avatar who deeded it. Returns NULL_KEY for avatars, untransferred objects, or objects taken to inventory and re-rezzed.

name: OBJECT_LINK_NUMBER
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the index of the prim within its linkset, or 0 if unlinked.

name: OBJECT_LOCKED
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get a boolean, indicating if the object is locked.

name: OBJECT_MASS
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to retrieve the total mass (in kilograms) of the object's linkset.

name: OBJECT_MATERIAL
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to retrieve the physics material of the object, returning an integer matching a PRIM_MATERIAL_* constant.

name: OBJECT_NAME
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the prim's name, or the legacy name if the target is an avatar.

name: OBJECT_OMEGA
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the rotational (angular) velocity of an object in radians per second.

name: OBJECT_OWNER
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the owner's key. If the target is an avatar, their own key is returned. If group-owned, it returns NULL_KEY.

name: OBJECT_PATHFINDING_TYPE
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the pathfinding setting of an object in the region, returning an integer matching an OPT_* constant.

name: OBJECT_PERMS
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to retrieve the permissions of the object as five integers.

name: OBJECT_PERMS_COMBINED
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to retrieve the permissions of the object combined with all of its inventory items as five integers.

name: OBJECT_PHANTOM
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get a boolean indicating if phantom is enabled on the object. Returns 0 if the target is an avatar or attachment.

name: OBJECT_PHYSICS
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get a boolean indicating if physics is enabled on the object. Returns 0 if the target is an avatar or attachment.

name: OBJECT_PHYSICS_COST
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the physics cost of the object.

name: OBJECT_POS
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the prim's position in region coordinates. For an avatar outside the region, the returned position is relative to the script's region.

name: OBJECT_PRIM_COUNT
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the prim count of the object. Note that the script and target object must be owned by the same owner.

name: OBJECT_PRIM_EQUIVALENCE
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the prim equivalence of the object.

name: OBJECT_RENDER_WEIGHT
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the render weight (Avatar Rendering Cost) of an avatar based on viewer reports. Returns 0 for objects, -1 if unknown, and is capped at 500,000.

name: OBJECT_RETURN_PARCEL
description: Scope flag used with llReturnObjectsByOwner to return all objects on the same parcel as the script owned by the specified owner. Requires the script owner to be an estate manager or the parcel owner.

name: OBJECT_RETURN_PARCEL_OWNER
description: Scope flag used with llReturnObjectsByOwner to return all objects owned by the specified owner that are located on parcels owned by the script's owner.

name: OBJECT_RETURN_REGION
description: Scope flag used with llReturnObjectsByOwner to return all objects in the region owned by the specified owner. Only works if the script is owned by the estate owner or an estate manager.

name: OBJECT_REZZER_KEY
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to retrieve the key of the object or avatar that rezzed the target object.

name: OBJECT_REZ_TIME
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to retrieve the timestamp of when the object was rezzed.

name: OBJECT_ROOT
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the ID of the root prim. For an avatar, returns the root prim of the linkset they are sitting on (or the avatar's own ID if not sitting).

name: OBJECT_ROT
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the prim's rotation.

name: OBJECT_RUNNING_SCRIPT_COUNT
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the total number of running scripts attached to the target object or agent.

name: OBJECT_SCALE
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the size (scale) of the object.

name: OBJECT_SCRIPT_MEMORY
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the allocated script memory (or its upper limit) in bytes for the object or agent. This value is recomputed every 10-20 seconds.

name: OBJECT_SCRIPT_TIME
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the average script CPU time (in seconds) used per frame. Reports a 30-minute average, or the average since entering the region if present for less than 30 minutes.

name: OBJECT_SELECT_COUNT
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the total number of agents/avatars actively selecting any link in the object. Returns 0 if the target is an avatar.

name: OBJECT_SERVER_COST
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the server cost of the object.

name: OBJECT_SIT_COUNT
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the total number of agents sitting on any links in the object. Returns 0 if the target is an avatar.

name: OBJECT_STREAMING_COST
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the streaming (download) cost of the object.

name: OBJECT_TEMP_ATTACHED
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get a boolean indicating whether the object is temporarily attached.

name: OBJECT_TEMP_ON_REZ
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get a boolean indicating if temporary-on-rez is enabled for the object.

name: OBJECT_TEXT
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the floating (hover) text displayed above the object.

name: OBJECT_TEXT_ALPHA
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the alpha value of the floating (hover) text displayed above the object.

name: OBJECT_TEXT_COLOR
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the color vector of the floating (hover) text displayed above the object.

name: OBJECT_TOTAL_INVENTORY_COUNT
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the total number of inventory items inside the object. Requires the script and target object to share the same owner.

name: OBJECT_TOTAL_SCRIPT_COUNT
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the total number of scripts (both running and stopped) attached to the target object or agent.

name: OBJECT_UNKNOWN_DETAIL
description: Flag returned by llGetObjectDetails when an invalid flag is requested.

name: OBJECT_VELOCITY
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get the velocity vector of the target object.

name: OBJECT_VOLUME_DETECT
description: Flag used with llGetObjectDetails to get a boolean, indicating if the object is VolumeDetect.

name: OPT_AVATAR
description: Returned for avatars.

name: OPT_CHARACTER
description: Returned for pathfinding characters.

name: OPT_EXCLUSION_VOLUME
description: Returned for exclusion volumes.

name: OPT_LEGACY_LINKSET
description: Returned for movable obstacles, movable phantoms, physical, and volumedetect objects.

name: OPT_MATERIAL_VOLUME
description: Returned for material volumes.

name: OPT_OTHER
description: Returned for attachments, Linden trees, and grass.

name: OPT_STATIC_OBSTACLE
description: Returned for static obstacles.

name: OPT_WALKABLE
description: Returned for walkable objects.

name: OVERRIDE_GLTF_BASE_ALPHA
description: GLTF override setting used with llSetLinkGLTFOverrides to set the alpha for the face(s). Only impacts rendering when the alpha mode is set to PRIM_GLTF_ALPHA_MODE_BLEND.

name: OVERRIDE_GLTF_BASE_ALPHA_MASK
description: GLTF override setting used with llSetLinkGLTFOverrides to set the alpha cutoff level on the face(s) when the alpha mode is set to mask.

name: OVERRIDE_GLTF_BASE_ALPHA_MODE
description: GLTF override setting used with llSetLinkGLTFOverrides to set the alpha mode on the face(s) to one of the valid blend modes.

name: OVERRIDE_GLTF_BASE_COLOR_FACTOR
description: GLTF override setting used with llSetLinkGLTFOverrides to set the tinting color (specified in linear RGB) used for the base color. Use llsRGB2Linear to convert colors from Blinn-Phong to PBR.

name: OVERRIDE_GLTF_BASE_DOUBLE_SIDED
description: GLTF override setting used with llSetLinkGLTFOverrides. If set to TRUE, the texture on the face(s) will be rendered as double-sided.

name: OVERRIDE_GLTF_EMISSIVE_FACTOR
description: GLTF override setting used with llSetLinkGLTFOverrides to set the tint (specified in linear RGB) used for the emissive texture on the face(s).

name: OVERRIDE_GLTF_METALLIC_FACTOR
description: GLTF override setting used with llSetLinkGLTFOverrides to adjust the metallic factor on the specified face(s) to a value between 0 and 1.

name: OVERRIDE_GLTF_ROUGHNESS_FACTOR
description: GLTF override setting used with llSetLinkGLTFOverrides to adjust the roughness factor on the specified face(s) to a value between 0 and 1.

name: PARCEL_COUNT_GROUP
description: Used with llGetParcelPrimCount to get the total land impact of objects not owned by the parcel owner but set to or owned by the parcel's group.

name: PARCEL_COUNT_OTHER
description: Used with llGetParcelPrimCount to get the land impact of all objects that are neither owned by the parcel owner nor set to or owned by the parcel's group.

name: PARCEL_COUNT_OWNER
description: Used with llGetParcelPrimCount to get the total land impact of objects owned by the parcel owner.

name: PARCEL_COUNT_SELECTED
description: Used with llGetParcelPrimCount to get the total land impact of all objects currently selected or sat on.

name: PARCEL_COUNT_TEMP
description: Used with llGetParcelPrimCount to get the total land impact of temporary (temp-on-rez) objects.

name: PARCEL_COUNT_TOTAL
description: Used with llGetParcelPrimCount to get the total land impact of all objects on the parcel(s), excluding temporary (temp-on-rez) objects.

name: PARCEL_DETAILS_AREA
description: Flag used with llGetParcelDetails to retrieve the parcel's area in square meters (sqm).

name: PARCEL_DETAILS_DESC
description: Flag used with llGetParcelDetails to retrieve the description of the parcel (up to 127 characters).

name: PARCEL_DETAILS_FLAGS
description: Flag used with llGetParcelDetails to retrieve the parcel flags set on this parcel (see llGetParcelFlags for listings and meanings).

name: PARCEL_DETAILS_GROUP
description: Flag used with llGetParcelDetails to retrieve the parcel group's 36-character key.

name: PARCEL_DETAILS_ID
description: Flag used with llGetParcelDetails to retrieve the parcel's 36-character UUID/key.

name: PARCEL_DETAILS_LANDING_LOOKAT
description: Flag used with llGetParcelDetails to retrieve the lookat vector set for the landing point (teleport routing) on this parcel, if any.

name: PARCEL_DETAILS_LANDING_POINT
description: Flag used with llGetParcelDetails to retrieve the landing point vector set for this parcel, if any.

name: PARCEL_DETAILS_NAME
description: Flag used with llGetParcelDetails to retrieve the name of the parcel (up to 63 characters).

name: PARCEL_DETAILS_OWNER
description: Flag used with llGetParcelDetails to retrieve the parcel owner's 36-character key.

name: PARCEL_DETAILS_PRIM_CAPACITY
description: Flag used with llGetParcelDetails to retrieve the total prim capacity on this and all same-owner parcels, sim-wide (see llGetParcelMaxPrims for same-parcel-only and/or sim-wide reporting).

name: PARCEL_DETAILS_PRIM_USED
description: Flag used with llGetParcelDetails to retrieve the total prim usage on this and all same-owner parcels, sim-wide (see llGetParcelPrimCount to get prim counts by owner, group, or temporary status).

name: PARCEL_DETAILS_SCRIPT_DANGER
description: Flag used with llGetParcelDetails to check if the script is in danger (due to restrictions that impact script execution) on the indicated parcel; see llScriptDanger.

name: PARCEL_DETAILS_SEE_AVATARS
description: Flag used with llGetParcelDetails to retrieve the 'See and chat with residents on this parcel' avatar visibility setting.

name: PARCEL_DETAILS_TP_ROUTING
description: Flag used with llGetParcelDetails to retrieve the teleport routing setting for this parcel (0 = TP_ROUTING_BLOCKED, 1 = TP_ROUTING_LANDINGP, 2 = TP_ROUTING_FREE; rules are only enforced if a landing point is set).

name: PARCEL_FLAG_ALLOW_ALL_OBJECT_ENTRY
description: Flag used with llGetParcelFlags to check if the parcel allows all objects to enter.

name: PARCEL_FLAG_ALLOW_CREATE_GROUP_OBJECTS
description: Flag used with llGetParcelFlags to check if group members or scripts in group-deeded objects are allowed to create/rez objects on the parcel.

name: PARCEL_FLAG_ALLOW_CREATE_OBJECTS
description: Flag used with llGetParcelFlags to check if the parcel allows anyone to create objects.

name: PARCEL_FLAG_ALLOW_DAMAGE
description: Flag used with llGetParcelFlags to check if damage is enabled on the parcel.

name: PARCEL_FLAG_ALLOW_FLY
description: Flag used with llGetParcelFlags to check if flying is allowed on the parcel.

name: PARCEL_FLAG_ALLOW_GROUP_OBJECT_ENTRY
description: Flag used with llGetParcelFlags to check if the parcel restricts object entry to only group-owned and owner-owned objects.

name: PARCEL_FLAG_ALLOW_GROUP_SCRIPTS
description: Flag used with llGetParcelFlags to check if the parcel allows scripts owned by the parcel's group to run.

name: PARCEL_FLAG_ALLOW_LANDMARK
description: Flag used with llGetParcelFlags to check if the parcel allows landmarks to be created.

name: PARCEL_FLAG_ALLOW_SCRIPTS
description: Flag used with llGetParcelFlags to check if scripts (including outside scripts) are allowed to run on the parcel.

name: PARCEL_FLAG_ALLOW_TERRAFORM
description: Flag used with llGetParcelFlags to check if the parcel allows anyone to terraform the land.

name: PARCEL_FLAG_LOCAL_SOUND_ONLY
description: Flag used with llGetParcelFlags to check if the parcel restricts spatialized sounds to the parcel (preventing outside sound from being heard inside).

name: PARCEL_FLAG_RESTRICT_PUSHOBJECT
description: Flag used with llGetParcelFlags to check if the parcel restricts the use of llPushObject by non-owners (or non-group officers if group-owned).

name: PARCEL_FLAG_USE_ACCESS_GROUP
description: Flag used with llGetParcelFlags to check if the parcel limits access to group members.

name: PARCEL_FLAG_USE_ACCESS_LIST
description: Flag used with llGetParcelFlags to check if the parcel limits access to a specific list of residents (avatars).

name: PARCEL_FLAG_USE_BAN_LIST
description: Flag used with llGetParcelFlags to check if the parcel uses a ban list (including restricting access based on payment information).

name: PARCEL_FLAG_USE_LAND_PASS_LIST
description: Flag used with llGetParcelFlags to check if the parcel restricts access via purchasable land passes (sold for L$).

name: PARCEL_MEDIA_COMMAND_AGENT
description: Command used with llParcelMediaCommandList to apply the specified media command to the designated agent only.

name: PARCEL_MEDIA_COMMAND_AUTO_ALIGN
description: Command used with llParcelMediaCommandList to toggle or set the parcel media option 'Auto scale content'.

name: PARCEL_MEDIA_COMMAND_DESC
description: Command used with llParcelMediaCommandList or llParcelMediaQuery to get or set the parcel media description.

name: PARCEL_MEDIA_COMMAND_LOOP
description: Command used with llParcelMediaCommandList to start the media stream playing from the current frame and have it loop back to the beginning when it reaches the end.

name: PARCEL_MEDIA_COMMAND_LOOP_SET
description: Command used with llParcelMediaCommandList or llParcelMediaQuery to get or set the parcel's media looping variable or loop duration (which may have functionality limitations; see VWR-19712).

name: PARCEL_MEDIA_COMMAND_PAUSE
description: Command used with llParcelMediaCommandList to pause the media stream on the current frame.

name: PARCEL_MEDIA_COMMAND_PLAY
description: Command used with llParcelMediaCommandList to play the media stream from its current frame, stopping when the end is reached.

name: PARCEL_MEDIA_COMMAND_SIZE
description: Command used with llParcelMediaCommandList or llParcelMediaQuery to get or set the parcel media pixel resolution.

name: PARCEL_MEDIA_COMMAND_STOP
description: Command used with llParcelMediaCommandList to stop the media stream and rewind it to the first frame.

name: PARCEL_MEDIA_COMMAND_TEXTURE
description: Command used with llParcelMediaCommandList or llParcelMediaQuery to get or set the parcel's media texture.

name: PARCEL_MEDIA_COMMAND_TIME
description: Command used with llParcelMediaCommandList to jump to a specific timestamp in the media stream, specified in floating-point seconds.

name: PARCEL_MEDIA_COMMAND_TYPE
description: Command used with llParcelMediaCommandList or llParcelMediaQuery to get or set the parcel media MIME type (e.g., 'text/html').

name: PARCEL_MEDIA_COMMAND_UNLOAD
description: Command used with llParcelMediaCommandList to completely unload the media and restore the face's original texture.

name: PARCEL_MEDIA_COMMAND_URL
description: Command used with llParcelMediaCommandList or llParcelMediaQuery to get or set the parcel's media URL.

name: PARCEL_SALE_AGENT
description: Option used with llSetParcelForSale to specify the agent ID authorized to buy the parcel. If none is set, any agent can purchase it.

name: PARCEL_SALE_ERROR_BAD_PARAMS
description: Error code indicating the parameters provided to set the parcel sale information are invalid.

name: PARCEL_SALE_ERROR_INVALID_PRICE
description: Error code indicating the specified parcel price is invalid (e.g., less than or equal to 0).

name: PARCEL_SALE_ERROR_IN_ESCROW
description: Error code indicating the parcel is in escrow and cannot be put up for sale.

name: PARCEL_SALE_ERROR_NO_PARCEL
description: Error code indicating the parcel could not be found.

name: PARCEL_SALE_ERROR_NO_PERMISSIONS
description: Error code indicating the script lacks the required permissions to set the parcel sale information.

name: PARCEL_SALE_OBJECTS
description: Option used with llSetParcelForSale. If set to TRUE, objects on the parcel are included in the sale.

name: PARCEL_SALE_OK
description: Status code indicating the parcel sale information was successfully set.

name: PARCEL_SALE_PRICE
description: Option used with llSetParcelForSale to set the parcel price. If no authorized agent is set, the price must be greater than 0.

name: PASSIVE
description: Identifies static or non-moving in-world objects (which do not consume active server resources). In llDetectedType(), indicates non-physical objects. In llSensor()/llSensorRepeat() filters, searches for non-physical, non-scripted, inactive, or non-moving physical objects.

name: PASS_ALWAYS
description: Used with event-passing functions (e.g., llPassTouches, llPassCollisions) to ensure events are always passed from the child prim to the root prim, regardless of whether they are handled by child script handlers.

name: PASS_IF_NOT_HANDLED
description: Used with event-passing functions (default behavior) to pass events from the child prim to the root prim only if there is no script handling the event in the child.

name: PASS_NEVER
description: Used with event-passing functions to ensure events are never passed from the child prim to the root prim, regardless of whether they are handled by child script handlers.

name: PATROL_PAUSE_AT_WAYPOINTS
description: Option parameter for llPatrolPoints (defaults to FALSE). If TRUE, the character slows down and momentarily pauses at each waypoint. If FALSE, the character moves to the next waypoint at full speed with no pause.

name: PAYMENT_INFO_ON_FILE
description: Agent data flag returned by llRequestAgentData indicating if the user has payment information on file.

name: PAYMENT_INFO_USED
description: Agent data flag returned by llRequestAgentData indicating if the user has ever used their payment information.

name: PAY_DEFAULT
description: Used with llSetPayPrice to use the default value for the specified quick pay button.

name: PAY_HIDE
description: Used with llSetPayPrice to hide the specified quick pay button completely.

name: PERMISSION_ATTACH
description: Runtime permission that allows the script to successfully attach to or detach from the agent using llAttachToAvatar.

name: PERMISSION_CHANGE_JOINTS
description: (Not yet implemented)

name: PERMISSION_CHANGE_LINKS
description: Runtime permission that allows the script to successfully create, break, or modify links to other objects using llCreateLink, llBreakLink, or llBreakAllLinks.

name: PERMISSION_CHANGE_PERMISSIONS
description: (Not yet implemented)

name: PERMISSION_CONTROL_CAMERA
description: Runtime permission that allows the script to control the agent's camera. The agent must be sitting on or attached to the object, and permission is automatically revoked on standing up or detaching.

name: PERMISSION_DEBIT
description: Runtime permission that allows the script to successfully call llGiveMoney or llTransferLindenDollars to debit the owner's account.

name: PERMISSION_OVERRIDE_ANIMATIONS
description: Runtime permission that allows the script to configure and override default animations on the agent.

name: PERMISSION_PRIVILEGED_LAND_ACCESS
description: Runtime permission that grants the script privileged access to land parcel functions, which is required to use llSetParcelForSale.

name: PERMISSION_RELEASE_OWNERSHIP
description: (Not yet implemented)

name: PERMISSION_REMAP_CONTROLS
description: (Not yet implemented)

name: PERMISSION_RETURN_OBJECTS
description: Runtime permission required to use the llReturnObjectsByID and llReturnObjectsByOwner functions to return objects from parcels.

name: PERMISSION_SILENT_ESTATE_MANAGEMENT
description: Runtime permission that allows the script to manage estate access rules via llManageEstateAccess without notifying the object owner of the changes.

name: PERMISSION_TAKE_CONTROLS
description: Runtime permission that allows the script to successfully call the llTakeControls function to intercept the agent's controls.

name: PERMISSION_TELEPORT
description: Runtime permission required to teleport the agent using the llTeleportAgent function.

name: PERMISSION_TRACK_CAMERA
description: Runtime permission that allows the script to track the agent's camera position and rotation.

name: PERMISSION_TRIGGER_ANIMATION
description: Runtime permission that allows the script to start or stop animations on the agent (such as using llStartAnimation).

name: PERM_ALL
description: Permissions mask representing a combination of move, modify, copy, and transfer permissions.

name: PERM_COPY
description: Permissions mask representing copy permission.

name: PERM_MODIFY
description: Permissions mask representing modify permission.

name: PERM_MOVE
description: Permissions mask representing move permission.

name: PERM_TRANSFER
description: Permissions mask representing transfer permission.

name: PI
description: Mathematical constant pi, representing the number of radians in a half circle (semi-circle). When used in sensor functions, it specifies a full sphere scan.

name: PING_PONG
description: Used with texture animation functions to cause the animation to play forward first, and then in reverse.

name: PI_BY_TWO
description: Mathematical constant pi/2, representing the number of radians in a quarter circle. When used in sensor functions, it specifies a hemisphere scan.

name: PRIM_ALLOW_UNSIT
description: Prim parameter for allowing or restricting manual standing for avatars seated on this prim within a valid experience. Ignored if the avatar was not seated via llSitOnLink. When restriction is active, participating seated avatars cannot manually stand or select another prim to sit on.

name: PRIM_ALPHA_MODE
description: Prim parameter used to set diffuse texture alpha rendering mode attributes. Requires face, alpha_mode (PRIM_ALPHA_MODE_BLEND, _NONE, _MASK, or _EMISSIVE), and alpha_cutoff (used only for _MASK) parameters.

name: PRIM_ALPHA_MODE_BLEND
description: Prim parameter setting for PRIM_ALPHA_MODE. Directs the face to use alpha blending for diffuse texture rendering (if an alpha channel exists). Also used as the default value to clear material settings from a prim face.

name: PRIM_ALPHA_MODE_EMISSIVE
description: Prim parameter setting for PRIM_ALPHA_MODE. Renders the diffuse texture's alpha channel as an emissivity mask. Pixels render with an emissivity corresponding to their opacity under all lighting conditions (fully opaque pixels effectively render as 'full bright').

name: PRIM_ALPHA_MODE_MASK
description: Prim parameter setting for PRIM_ALPHA_MODE. Renders the diffuse texture's alpha channel on a binary per-pixel basis; pixels more opaque than the alpha cutoff render as fully opaque, while pixels below the cutoff render as fully transparent.

name: PRIM_ALPHA_MODE_NONE
description: Prim parameter setting for PRIM_ALPHA_MODE. Directs the face to ignore the alpha channel of the diffuse texture and render as completely opaque (default setting when a material face lacks an alpha channel).

name: PRIM_BUMP_BARK
description: Face bump mapping setting: bark.

name: PRIM_BUMP_BLOBS
description: Face bump mapping setting: petridish (blobby amoeba-like shapes).

name: PRIM_BUMP_BRICKS
description: Face bump mapping setting: bricks.

name: PRIM_BUMP_BRIGHT
description: Face bump mapping setting: brightness (generated from highlights).

name: PRIM_BUMP_CHECKER
description: Face bump mapping setting: checker.

name: PRIM_BUMP_CONCRETE
description: Face bump mapping setting: concrete.

name: PRIM_BUMP_DARK
description: Face bump mapping setting: darkness (generated from lowlights).

name: PRIM_BUMP_DISKS
description: Face bump mapping setting: discs (packed circles).

name: PRIM_BUMP_GRAVEL
description: Face bump mapping setting: gravel.

name: PRIM_BUMP_LARGETILE
description: Face bump mapping setting: stonetile (large tile).

name: PRIM_BUMP_NONE
description: Face bump mapping setting: none (no bump map).

name: PRIM_BUMP_SHINY
description: Prim parameter used to get or set both the shininess and bump mapping settings of a face.

name: PRIM_BUMP_SIDING
description: Face bump mapping setting: siding.

name: PRIM_BUMP_STONE
description: Face bump mapping setting: cutstone (blocks).

name: PRIM_BUMP_STUCCO
description: Face bump mapping setting: stucco.

name: PRIM_BUMP_SUCTION
description: Face bump mapping setting: suction (rings).

name: PRIM_BUMP_TILE
description: Face bump mapping setting: crustytile.

name: PRIM_BUMP_WEAVE
description: Face bump mapping setting: weave.

name: PRIM_BUMP_WOOD
description: Face bump mapping setting: woodgrain.

name: PRIM_CAST_SHADOWS
description: Deprecated prim parameter representing shadow casting settings for the primitive.

name: PRIM_CLICK_ACTION
description: Prim parameter followed by a CLICK_ACTION_* constant to specify the default action taken when a user clicks or touches the prim.

name: PRIM_COLLISION_SOUND
description: Prim parameter to set the collision sound UUID and volume level for the prim.

name: PRIM_COLOR
description:
Prim parameter to get or set the Blinn-Phong color and opacity of a face.

integer face – face number or ALL_SIDES
vector color – color in RGB <R, G, B> (<0.0, 0.0, 0.0> = black, <1.0, 1.0, 1.0> = white)
float alpha – from 0.0 (clear) to 1.0 (solid) (0.0 <= alpha <= 1.0)

name: PRIM_DAMAGE
description: Prim parameter used to get or set the damage amount and damage type delivered by the prim on collision.

name: PRIM_DESC
description: Prim parameter [PRIM_DESC, string description] to get or set the prim's description (equivalent to llGetObjectDesc/llSetObjectDesc).

name: PRIM_FLEXIBLE
description:
Prim parameter to get or set the prim's flexible configuration.

integer boolean – TRUE enables, FALSE disables
integer softness – ranges from 0 to 3
float gravity – ranges from -10.0 to 10.0
float friction – ranges from 0.0 to 10.0
float wind – ranges from 0.0 to 10.0
float tension – ranges from 0.0 to 10.0
vector force

name: PRIM_FULLBRIGHT
description: Prim parameter [PRIM_FULLBRIGHT, integer face, integer boolean] to get or set whether full-bright rendering is enabled on the specified face.

name: PRIM_GLOW
description: Prim parameter [PRIM_GLOW, integer face, float intensity] to get or set the glow intensity on a face (the compiler integer value is 25 if the named constant is rejected).

name: PRIM_GLTF_ALPHA_MODE_BLEND
description: GLTF alpha mode setting for PRIM_GLTF_BASE_COLOR. Renders the material with transparency (alpha blending) in linear color space. Transparency from the texture is multiplied by the material's opacity multiplier. Note: This mode can suffer from depth sorting and performance issues.

name: PRIM_GLTF_ALPHA_MODE_MASK
description: GLTF alpha mode setting for PRIM_GLTF_BASE_COLOR. Renders the material as fully opaque where the alpha value is greater than the alpha cutoff, and fully transparent otherwise.

name: PRIM_GLTF_ALPHA_MODE_OPAQUE
description: GLTF alpha mode setting for PRIM_GLTF_BASE_COLOR. Ignores the alpha channel entirely and renders the face material as completely opaque.

name: PRIM_GLTF_BASE_COLOR
description: Prim parameter to get or set the GLTF base color override of an object's face. Requires face, texture, repeats, offsets, rotation, linear_color (in linear space; use llsRGB2Linear), alpha_mode (PRIM_GLTF_ALPHA_MODE_*), alpha_cutoff, and double_sided arguments.

name: PRIM_GLTF_EMISSIVE
description: Prim parameter to get or set the GLTF emission override of a face. Requires face, texture, repeats, offsets, rotation, and emissive_tint (specified in linear space; use llsRGB2Linear).

name: PRIM_GLTF_METALLIC_ROUGHNESS
description: Prim parameter to get or set the GLTF occlusion/metallic/roughness override of a face. Requires face, texture, repeats, offsets, rotation, metallic_factor, and roughness_factor arguments.

name: PRIM_GLTF_NORMAL
description: Prim parameter to get or set the GLTF normal map override of a face. Requires face, texture, repeats, offsets, and rotation arguments.

name: PRIM_HEALTH
description: Prim parameter used to get or set the health of the prim. Objects default to 0 health.

name: PRIM_HOLE_CIRCLE
description: Parameter used with certain PRIM_TYPE_* flags to make a circular hole via the hole_shape parameter.

name: PRIM_HOLE_DEFAULT
description: Parameter used with certain PRIM_TYPE_* flags to make a hole of the same shape as the outer shape via the hole_shape parameter.

name: PRIM_HOLE_SQUARE
description: Parameter used with certain PRIM_TYPE_* flags to make a squarish hole via the hole_shape parameter.

name: PRIM_HOLE_TRIANGLE
description: Parameter used with certain PRIM_TYPE_* flags to make a triangular hole via the hole_shape parameter.

name: PRIM_LINK_TARGET
description: Prim parameter [PRIM_LINK_TARGET, integer link_target] used to get or set properties for multiple linked prims within a single primitive parameters call.

name: PRIM_MATERIAL
description: Prim parameter [PRIM_MATERIAL, integer PRIM_MATERIAL_*] to get or set the prim's material. The material determines the default collision sound, sprite, friction coefficient, and restitution coefficient (elasticity) without affecting mass.

name: PRIM_MATERIAL_FLESH
description: Prim material constant: flesh.

name: PRIM_MATERIAL_GLASS
description: Prim material constant: glass (features very low friction).

name: PRIM_MATERIAL_LIGHT
description: Deprecated prim material constant. Light is now a face property instead of a prim property; equivalent functionality is achieved using [PRIM_FULLBRIGHT, ALL_SIDES, TRUE].

name: PRIM_MATERIAL_METAL
description: Prim material constant: metal.

name: PRIM_MATERIAL_PLASTIC
description: Prim material constant: plastic.

name: PRIM_MATERIAL_RUBBER
description: Prim material constant: rubber.

name: PRIM_MATERIAL_STONE
description: Prim material constant: stone.

name: PRIM_MATERIAL_WOOD
description: Prim material constant: wood.

name: PRIM_MEDIA_ALT_IMAGE_ENABLE
description: Boolean. Gets or sets the default image state (the image a user sees before media is active) on a face. The default is specified by the server for that media type. Note: This flag is not currently implemented.

name: PRIM_MEDIA_AUTO_LOOP
description: Boolean. Gets or sets whether auto-looping is enabled for the face media.

name: PRIM_MEDIA_AUTO_PLAY
description: Boolean. Gets or sets whether media auto-plays when a resident is able to view it.

name: PRIM_MEDIA_AUTO_SCALE
description: Boolean. Gets or sets whether auto-scaling is enabled, which forces the media to fill the entire texture size.

name: PRIM_MEDIA_AUTO_ZOOM
description: Boolean. Gets or sets whether clicking the media triggers auto-zoom and auto-focus.

name: PRIM_MEDIA_CONTROLS
description: Integer. Gets or sets the style of media controls (can be set to PRIM_MEDIA_CONTROLS_STANDARD or PRIM_MEDIA_CONTROLS_MINI).

name: PRIM_MEDIA_CONTROLS_MINI
description: Mini web navigation controls constant; does not include an address bar.

name: PRIM_MEDIA_CONTROLS_STANDARD
description: Standard web navigation controls constant.

name: PRIM_MEDIA_CURRENT_URL
description: String. Gets or sets the current URL displayed on the chosen face (maximum 1024 characters). Changing this URL triggers media navigation.

name: PRIM_MEDIA_FIRST_CLICK_INTERACT
description: Boolean. Gets or sets what happens when someone click on a playing, but unfocused media face: TRUE: Does the same thing a focused media face does, and forwards the click to the web browser. FALSE: Focuses the media prim so that future clicks are forwarded to the web browser. Note: Viewer settings affect this flag. It works by default on most prims.

name: PRIM_MEDIA_HEIGHT_PIXELS
description: Integer. Gets or sets the height of the media in pixels.

name: PRIM_MEDIA_HOME_URL
description: String. Gets or sets the home URL for the chosen face (maximum 1024 characters).

name: PRIM_MEDIA_PERMS_CONTROL
description: Integer. Gets or sets the permissions mask controlling who can see the media control bar (PRIM_MEDIA_PERM_ANYONE, _GROUP, _NONE, or _OWNER).

name: PRIM_MEDIA_PERMS_INTERACT
description: Integer. Gets or sets the permissions mask controlling who can interact with the media (PRIM_MEDIA_PERM_ANYONE, _GROUP, _NONE, or _OWNER).

name: PRIM_MEDIA_WHITELIST
description: Gets or sets the media whitelist as an array of URL strings (up to 64 URLs or 1024 characters, whichever comes first). At the SLua level, provide a {string} array; the serializer encodes it as an escaped, comma-separated string for the underlying LSL API.

name: PRIM_MEDIA_WHITELIST_ENABLE
description: Boolean. Gets or sets whether media navigation is restricted to the URLs listed in PRIM_MEDIA_WHITELIST.

name: PRIM_MEDIA_WIDTH_PIXELS
description: Integer. Gets or sets the width of the media in pixels.

name: PRIM_NAME
description: Prim parameter [PRIM_NAME, string name] to get or set the prim's name (equivalent to llGetObjectName/llSetObjectName).

name: PRIM_NORMAL
description: Prim parameter to get or set the Blinn-Phong normal map texture settings of a face. Requires face, texture, repeats, offsets, and rotation_in_radians arguments.

name: PRIM_OMEGA
description:
Prim parameter to get, set, or disable a client-side physical-like rotation (analogous to llTargetOmega).

vector axis – arbitrary axis to rotate the object around
float spinrate – rate of rotation in radians per second
float gain – also modulates the final spinrate and disables the rotation behavior if zero

name: PRIM_PHANTOM
description: Prim parameter [PRIM_PHANTOM, integer boolean] to get or set whether phantom status is enabled.

name: PRIM_PHYSICS
