description: Prim parameter [PRIM_PHYSICS, integer boolean] to get or set whether the object responds to Second Life physics.

name: PRIM_PHYSICS_SHAPE_CONVEX
description: Physics shape type setting. Uses the convex hull of the prim shape to generate its physics representation (the default for mesh objects).

name: PRIM_PHYSICS_SHAPE_NONE
description: Physics shape type setting. Directs the physics engine to ignore this prim entirely, preventing it from contributing to the linkset's physics shape. Note: Cannot be applied to the root prim.

name: PRIM_PHYSICS_SHAPE_PRIM
description: Physics shape type setting. Uses the actual visible shape of the prim to determine its physics representation (the default for all non-mesh objects).

name: PRIM_PHYSICS_SHAPE_TYPE
description: Prim parameter used to get or set the type of shape the physics engine uses for the prim (PRIM_PHYSICS_SHAPE_NONE, _PRIM, or _CONVEX). Mainly used for physics optimization.

name: PRIM_POINT_LIGHT
description:
Prim parameter to configure local lighting.
Accepts color in linear space (use llsRGB2Linear to convert from sRGB).

integer boolean – TRUE enables, FALSE disables
vector linear_color – linear color in RGB <R, G, B&> (<0.0, 0.0, 0.0> = black, <1.0, 1.0, 1.0> = white)
float intensity – ranges from 0.0 to 1.0
float radius – ranges from 0.1 to 20.0
float falloff – ranges from 0.01 to 2.0

name: PRIM_POSITION
description: Prim parameter [PRIM_POSITION, vector position] to get or set the position of the prim in region coordinates (or local coordinates depending on the script context).

name: PRIM_POS_LOCAL
description: Prim parameter [PRIM_POS_LOCAL, vector position] to get or set the local position of a prim (equivalent to llGetLocalPos/llSetPos).

name: PRIM_PROJECTOR
description: Prim parameter [PRIM_PROJECTOR, string texture, float fov, float focus, float ambiance] to configure light projection settings. If the prim is not configured as a projector, the texture key will return NULL_KEY.

name: PRIM_REFLECTION_PROBE
description: Prim parameter to configure the object as a custom-placed reflection probe for Image-Based Lighting (IBL). Only affects objects inside its volume of influence.

name: PRIM_REFLECTION_PROBE_BOX
description: Flag option used with PRIM_REFLECTION_PROBE. When set, the reflection probe volume is a box; when unset, it defaults to a sphere.

name: PRIM_REFLECTION_PROBE_DYNAMIC
description: Flag option used with PRIM_REFLECTION_PROBE. When set, the probe dynamically includes avatars in its image-based lighting reflections (which carries a rendering performance cost).

name: PRIM_REFLECTION_PROBE_MIRROR
description: Flag option used with PRIM_REFLECTION_PROBE. When set, intersecting low-roughness PBR materials act as mirrors. Note: Mirrors do not reflect avatars unless PRIM_REFLECTION_PROBE_DYNAMIC is also enabled, and they carry a performance cost.

name: PRIM_RENDER_MATERIAL
description: Prim parameter [PRIM_RENDER_MATERIAL, integer face, string material] to get or set face material settings. Note: Setting this clears most PRIM_GLTF_* properties on the face, except for repeats, offsets, and rotation_in_radians.

name: PRIM_ROTATION
description: Prim parameter [PRIM_ROTATION, rotation global_rot] to get or set the global rotation of the prim (equivalent to llGetRot/llSetRot; note that setting this on child prims may be broken).

name: PRIM_ROT_LOCAL
description: Prim parameter [PRIM_ROT_LOCAL, rotation local_rot] to get or set the local rotation of a prim (equivalent to llGetLocalRot/llSetLocalRot).

name: PRIM_SCRIPTED_SIT_ONLY
description: Prim parameter restricting manual sitting on this prim. When active, sitting can only be initiated via llSitOnLink; manual sitting attempts fail. This restriction applies even outside experience-enabled regions.

name: PRIM_SCULPT_FLAG_ANIMESH
description: Read-only flag for PRIM_TYPE_SCULPT to query whether the object is an Animated Mesh (Animesh).

name: PRIM_SCULPT_FLAG_INVERT
description: Flag for PRIM_TYPE_SCULPT to render the sculpted prim inside-out by inverting the normals of each polygon.

name: PRIM_SCULPT_FLAG_MIRROR
description: Flag for PRIM_TYPE_SCULPT to render a mirror-image of the sculpted prim, mirrored across the X-axis.

name: PRIM_SCULPT_TYPE_CYLINDER
description: Sculpt type option for PRIM_TYPE_SCULPT that stitches the left side to the right to produce a cylinder-shaped sculpted prim.

name: PRIM_SCULPT_TYPE_MASK
description: Bitmask used when parsing sculpted prim properties (PRIM_TYPE_SCULPT) from llGetPrimitiveParams to separate the base sculpt type from modifying flags (invert or mirror).

name: PRIM_SCULPT_TYPE_MESH
description: Sculpt type option for PRIM_TYPE_SCULPT indicating the object is a uploaded Mesh model.

name: PRIM_SCULPT_TYPE_PLANE
description: Sculpt type option for PRIM_TYPE_SCULPT that performs no stitching or converging, producing a flat plane-shaped sculpted prim.

name: PRIM_SCULPT_TYPE_SPHERE
description: Sculpt type option for PRIM_TYPE_SCULPT that stitches the left side to the right and separately converges the top and bottom to produce a sphere-shaped sculpted prim.

name: PRIM_SCULPT_TYPE_TORUS
description: Sculpt type option for PRIM_TYPE_SCULPT that stitches top-to-bottom and left-to-right to produce a torus-shaped sculpted prim.

name: PRIM_SHINY_HIGH
description: Sets the highest intensity legacy face shininess setting.

name: PRIM_SHINY_LOW
description: Sets the lowest intensity legacy face shininess setting.

name: PRIM_SHINY_MEDIUM
description: Sets a medium intensity legacy face shininess setting.

name: PRIM_SHINY_NONE
description: Disables the legacy face shininess setting.

name: PRIM_SIT_FLAGS
description: Prim parameter used to get or set sit-related flags currently active on the prim.

name: PRIM_SIT_TARGET
description: Prim parameter [PRIM_SIT_TARGET, integer boolean, vector offset, rotation rot] to get or set the prim's sit target. Setting the boolean to FALSE deactivates the target. Unlike llLinkSitTarget, offset <0.0, 0.0, 0.0> can be explicitly set.

name: PRIM_SIZE
description: Prim parameter [PRIM_SIZE, vector size] to get or set the prim's physical dimensions (equivalent to llGetScale/llSetScale).

name: PRIM_SLICE
description: Prim parameter [PRIM_SLICE, vector slice] to get or set the prim's slice values (a shape attribute equivalent to advanced cut).

name: PRIM_SPECULAR
description: Prim parameter to get or set the Blinn-Phong specular map texture settings of a face. Requires face, texture, repeats, offsets, rotation_in_radians, color, glossy, and environment arguments.

name: PRIM_TEMP_ON_REZ
description: Prim parameter used to get or set the object's temporary status. Temporary objects live until the next garbage collection cycle (about 1 minute), do not count against normal prim limits, but are subject to regional limits.

name: PRIM_TEXGEN
description: Prim parameter [PRIM_TEXGEN, integer face, integer mode] to get or set the texture mapping mode of the face.

name: PRIM_TEXGEN_DEFAULT
description: Texture mapping mode setting for PRIM_TEXGEN. Specifies that texture repeat units are measured in texture repeats per face.

name: PRIM_TEXGEN_PLANAR
description: Texture mapping mode setting for PRIM_TEXGEN. Specifies that texture repeat units are measured in repeats per half-meter (unlike the in-world editor, which measures in repeats per meter).

name: PRIM_TEXT
description: Prim parameter [PRIM_TEXT, string text, vector color, float alpha] to get or set the object's floating/hover text (equivalent to llSetText).

name: PRIM_TEXTURE
description: Prim parameter [PRIM_TEXTURE, integer face, string texture, vector repeats, vector offsets, float rotation_in_radians] to get or set the Blinn-Phong diffuse texture settings of a face.

name: PRIM_TYPE
description: Prim parameter used to get or set the geometric shape type (PRIM_TYPE_*) and its associated parameters.

name: PRIM_TYPE_BOX
description: Shape parameter for PRIM_TYPE used to define the prim as a box and configure its shape properties.

name: PRIM_TYPE_CYLINDER
description: Shape parameter for PRIM_TYPE used to define the prim as a cylinder and configure its shape properties.

name: PRIM_TYPE_PRISM
description: Shape parameter for PRIM_TYPE used to define the prim as a prism and configure its shape properties.

name: PRIM_TYPE_RING
description: Shape parameter for PRIM_TYPE used to define the prim as a ring and configure its shape properties.

name: PRIM_TYPE_SCULPT
description: Shape parameter for PRIM_TYPE used to define the prim as a sculpted prim (sculpty) or mesh of a specific type.

name: PRIM_TYPE_SPHERE
description: Shape parameter for PRIM_TYPE used to define the prim as a sphere and configure its shape properties.

name: PRIM_TYPE_TORUS
description: Shape parameter for PRIM_TYPE used to define the prim as a torus and configure its shape properties.

name: PRIM_TYPE_TUBE
description: Shape parameter for PRIM_TYPE used to define the prim as a tube and configure its shape properties.

name: PROFILE_NONE
description: Disables script profiling.

name: PROFILE_SCRIPT_MEMORY
description: Enables script memory profiling, tracking the maximum amount of memory consumed while it is active.

name: PSYS_PART_BF_DEST_COLOR
description: Scales the RGBA values by the RGBA values of the destination.

name: PSYS_PART_BF_ONE
description: PSYS_PART_BF_ONE

name: PSYS_PART_BF_ONE_MINUS_DEST_COLOR
description: Scales the RGBA values by the inverted RGBA values of the destination.

name: PSYS_PART_BF_ONE_MINUS_SOURCE_ALPHA
description: Scales the RGBA values by the inverted alpha values of the particle source.

name: PSYS_PART_BF_ONE_MINUS_SOURCE_COLOR
description: Scales the RGBA values by the inverted RGBA values of the particle source.

name: PSYS_PART_BF_SOURCE_ALPHA
description: Scales the RGBA values by the alpha values of the particle source.

name: PSYS_PART_BF_SOURCE_COLOR
description: Scales the RGBA values by the RGBA values of the particle source.

name: PSYS_PART_BF_ZERO
description: Zeros out the source or destination RGBA values.

name: PSYS_PART_BLEND_FUNC_DEST
description: Integer parameter defining the destination blending function.

name: PSYS_PART_BLEND_FUNC_SOURCE
description: Integer parameter defining the source blending function.

name: PSYS_PART_BOUNCE_MASK
description: Particle flag causing particles to bounce off a plane at the emitter object's Z height.

name: PSYS_PART_EMISSIVE_MASK
description: Particle flag that makes particles full-bright and unaffected by global lighting (sunlight). Otherwise, particles are lit by current global lighting or local point lights.

name: PSYS_PART_END_ALPHA
description: Float parameter that determines the ending alpha (transparency) of the particles.

name: PSYS_PART_END_COLOR
description: Vector parameter <r, g, b> that determines the ending color of the particles.

name: PSYS_PART_END_GLOW
description: Float parameter that determines the ending glow value of the particles.

name: PSYS_PART_END_SCALE
description: Vector parameter <sx, sy, z> defining the ending size of the particle billboard in meters (z-axis value is ignored).

name: PSYS_PART_FLAGS
description: Integer bitfield parameter specifying the simulation flags for emitted particles. Multiple flags can be combined using bitwise OR (|).

name: PSYS_PART_FOLLOW_SRC_MASK
description: Particle flag causing particle positions to remain relative to the position and movement of the emitter. Enabling this flag disables the PSYS_SRC_BURST_RADIUS rule.

name: PSYS_PART_FOLLOW_VELOCITY_MASK
description: Particle flag causing particles to rotate and orient their vertical 'top' toward their direction of movement or emission. Otherwise, they remain vertically oriented with the top of the texture facing up.

name: PSYS_PART_INTERP_COLOR_MASK
description: Particle flag causing the particle's color and alpha to smoothly interpolate from their START values to their END values over its lifetime.

name: PSYS_PART_INTERP_SCALE_MASK
description: Particle flag causing the particle's size/scale to transition from its START setting to its END setting over its lifetime.

name: PSYS_PART_MAX_AGE
description: Float parameter specifying the lifetime (age in seconds) of an individual particle before it dies.

name: PSYS_PART_RIBBON_MASK
description: Particle flag that joins emitted particles into a continuous ribbon strip. Textures stretch to join adjacent edges. Width is controlled by the 'x' start/end scale; 'y' controls maximum visibility distance. Ribbon segments are not camera-facing, mimic the emitter's Z-axis, and require horizontal movement to render.

name: PSYS_PART_START_ALPHA
description: Float parameter that determines the starting alpha (transparency) of the particles.

name: PSYS_PART_START_COLOR
description: Vector parameter <r, g, b> that determines the starting color of the particles.

name: PSYS_PART_START_GLOW
description: Float parameter that determines the starting glow value of the particles.

name: PSYS_PART_START_SCALE
description: Vector parameter <sx, sy, z> defining the starting size of the particle billboard in meters (z-axis value is ignored).

name: PSYS_PART_TARGET_LINEAR_MASK
description: Particle flag causing emitted particles to move in a straight, evenly-spaced line toward the PSYS_SRC_TARGET_KEY target. Ignores non-DROP patterns, radius, burst speeds, angles, omega, acceleration, and wind. Combining with bounce while target is below emitter deflects particles upward.

name: PSYS_PART_TARGET_POS_MASK
description: Particle flag causing emitted particles to change course and travel toward the target specified by PSYS_SRC_TARGET_KEY during their lifetime. If no valid or reachable target is set, particles target the emitting prim itself.

name: PSYS_PART_WIND_MASK
description: Particle flag that applies wind as a secondary force on the particles, damping their velocity toward the wind velocity.

name: PSYS_SRC_ACCEL
description: Vector parameter <x, y, z> specifying the constant acceleration to apply to particles.

name: PSYS_SRC_ANGLE_BEGIN
description: Float parameter specifying the angle in radians where particles will not be created (for ANGLE patterns).

name: PSYS_SRC_ANGLE_END
description: Float parameter specifying the ending angle in radians to be filled with particles (for ANGLE patterns). If smaller than angle_begin, their roles are swapped.

name: PSYS_SRC_BURST_PART_COUNT
description: Integer parameter specifying the number of particles to release in each burst.

name: PSYS_SRC_BURST_RADIUS
description: Float parameter specifying the radial distance from the emitter's center at which particles are created.

name: PSYS_SRC_BURST_RATE
description: Float parameter specifying the interval in seconds between particle bursts.

name: PSYS_SRC_BURST_SPEED_MAX
description: Float parameter specifying the maximum initial speed of emitted particles.

name: PSYS_SRC_BURST_SPEED_MIN
description: Float parameter specifying the minimum initial speed of emitted particles.

name: PSYS_SRC_INNERANGLE
description: Float parameter specifying the inner angle of the arc for ANGLE or ANGLE_CONE patterns. The specified inner area will not contain particles.

name: PSYS_SRC_MAX_AGE
description: Float parameter specifying the active duration of the particle system in seconds (0.0 means forever).

name: PSYS_SRC_OMEGA
description: Vector parameter setting the angular velocity used to rotate the emission axis for ANGLE and ANGLE_CONE patterns.

name: PSYS_SRC_OUTERANGLE
description: Float parameter specifying the outer angle of the arc for ANGLE or ANGLE_CONE patterns. The area between the outer and inner angles is filled with particles.

name: PSYS_SRC_PATTERN
description: Integer parameter specifying the generation pattern (PSYS_SRC_PATTERN_*) used to emit particles.

name: PSYS_SRC_PATTERN_ANGLE
description: Emission pattern that sprays particles outward in a flat circular, semi-circular, arc, or ray-shaped 2D area (around the prim's local X-axis) as defined by the start/end and inner/outer angle parameters.

name: PSYS_SRC_PATTERN_ANGLE_CONE
description: Emission pattern that sprays particles outward in a 3D spherical, conical, or ring-shaped area defined by the start/end and inner/outer angle parameters. Can emulate the EXPLODE pattern if angles are set to 0.0 and PI.

name: PSYS_SRC_PATTERN_ANGLE_CONE_EMPTY
description: Incomplete emission pattern that behaves identically to the DROP pattern. Intended to invert the ANGLE parameters to define an empty area where particles are not sprayed.

name: PSYS_SRC_PATTERN_DROP
description: Emission pattern that drops particles at the source position with no initial velocity. Overrides burst radius, minimum speed, and maximum speed settings to 0.0.

name: PSYS_SRC_PATTERN_EXPLODE
description: Emission pattern that shoots particles outward in all directions using the burst parameters.

name: PSYS_SRC_TARGET_KEY
description: Key (UUID) of the target object that particles travel toward when PSYS_PART_TARGET_POS_MASK or PSYS_PART_TARGET_LINEAR_MASK is enabled.

name: PSYS_SRC_TEXTURE
description: String parameter specifying the inventory name or UUID asset key of the texture used for the particles.

name: PUBLIC_CHANNEL
description: Integer constant representing the open local chat channel. Passing this to chat functions (llSay, llWhisper, llShout) prints text to the publicly heard chat seen by nearby users and objects.

name: PURSUIT_FUZZ_FACTOR
description: Option for llPursue that selects a random destination near the PURSUIT_OFFSET (range is 0 to 1, where 1 is most random). Requires a non-zero PURSUIT_OFFSET.

name: PURSUIT_GOAL_TOLERANCE
description: Option for llPursue defining how close (between 0.25m and 10m) the character must be to consider the goal reached.

name: PURSUIT_INTERCEPT
description: Option for llPursue specifying whether the pathfinding character attempts to predict and intercept the target's future location.

name: PURSUIT_OFFSET
description: Option for llPursue specifying a constant position offset relative to the target for the character to navigate toward.

name: PU_EVADE_HIDDEN
description: Path update status code triggered when an llEvade character determines it has successfully hidden from its pursuer.

name: PU_EVADE_SPOTTED
description: Path update status code triggered when an llEvade character switches from hiding to running.

name: PU_FAILURE_DYNAMIC_PATHFINDING_DISABLED
description: Path update failure code triggered when a character enters a region where dynamic pathfinding has been disabled in the Region Debug Console.

name: PU_FAILURE_INVALID_GOAL
description: Path update failure code triggered when the specified goal is not on the region's navigation mesh (navmesh) and is unreachable.

name: PU_FAILURE_INVALID_START
description: Path update failure code triggered when the character is at an unnavigable starting position (e.g., off the navmesh or too high above it).

name: PU_FAILURE_NO_NAVMESH
description: Path update fatal error triggered when there is no navmesh generated for the region (typically indicates a server failure).

name: PU_FAILURE_NO_VALID_DESTINATION
description: Path update failure code triggered when no reachable destinations remain (e.g., all patrol waypoints are blocked).

name: PU_FAILURE_OTHER
description: Path update failure code representing an unspecified or general failure.

name: PU_FAILURE_PARCEL_UNREACHABLE
description: Path update failure code triggered when a character is blocked from entering a parcel (e.g., the parcel is full or object entry was disabled after the navmesh was baked).

name: PU_FAILURE_TARGET_GONE
description: Path update failure code triggered when an llPursue or llEvade target can no longer be tracked (e.g., they left the region or went more than ~30m outside region boundaries).

name: PU_FAILURE_UNREACHABLE
description: Path update failure code triggered when a previously valid goal becomes unreachable (e.g., an obstacle blocks the path).

name: PU_GOAL_REACHED
description: Path update status code triggered when the character reaches its goal and either stops or chooses a new goal (if wandering).

name: PU_SLOWDOWN_DISTANCE_REACHED
description: Path update status code triggered when the character enters the slowdown distance near its current goal.

name: RAD_TO_DEG
description: 180/PI. Multiply a value in radians by this number to convert it to degrees.

name: RCERR_CAST_TIME_EXCEEDED
description: Raycast error indicating the parcel or agent exceeded the maximum allocated raycast time. Waiting a few frames and retrying will usually succeed as resources replenish.

name: RCERR_SIM_PERF_LOW
description: Raycast error indicating the request failed due to low simulator performance. Wait before retrying, and if possible, reduce scene complexity.

name: RCERR_UNKNOWN
description: Raycast error indicating an unspecified failure.

name: RC_DATA_FLAGS
description: Flag used with llCastRay to configure returned data.

name: RC_DETECT_PHANTOM
description: Flag used with llCastRay. If set to TRUE (or non-zero), detects both phantom and volume-detect objects (they cannot be filtered individually). This overrides the RC_REJECT_NONPHYSICAL and RC_REJECT_PHYSICAL settings in RC_REJECT_TYPES.

name: RC_GET_LINK_NUM
description: Flag used with llCastRay causing the results stride to include the specific link number that was hit.

name: RC_GET_NORMAL
description: Flag used with llCastRay causing the results stride to include the surface normal vector of the impact point.

name: RC_GET_ROOT_KEY
description: Flag used with llCastRay that returns the key of the hit object's root prim instead of the hit child prim.

name: RC_MAX_HITS
description: Flag used with llCastRay to set the maximum number of hits to return (up to 256). To avoid performance issues, keep this value small.

name: RC_REJECT_AGENTS
description: Flag used with llCastRay to prevent the detection of avatars.

name: RC_REJECT_LAND
description: Flag used with llCastRay to ignore the actual terrain ground (land).

name: RC_REJECT_NONPHYSICAL
description: Flag used with llCastRay to ignore non-physical objects.

name: RC_REJECT_PHYSICAL
description: Flag used with llCastRay to ignore physical objects.

name: RC_REJECT_TYPES
description: Flag used with llCastRay to define a mask for ignoring specific types of objects and avatars.

name: REGION_FLAG_ALLOW_DAMAGE
description: Flag used with llGetRegionFlags to check if the region is entirely damage-enabled.

name: REGION_FLAG_ALLOW_DIRECT_TELEPORT
description: Flag used with llGetRegionFlags to check if direct teleportation is allowed in the region.

name: REGION_FLAG_BLOCK_FLY
description: Flag used with llGetRegionFlags to check if flying is blocked/disabled in the region.

name: REGION_FLAG_BLOCK_TERRAFORM
description: Flag used with llGetRegionFlags to check if terraforming is disabled in the region.

name: REGION_FLAG_DISABLE_COLLISIONS
description: Flag used with llGetRegionFlags to check if collisions have been disabled in the region.

name: REGION_FLAG_DISABLE_PHYSICS
description: Flag used with llGetRegionFlags to check if physics has been disabled in the region.

name: REGION_FLAG_FIXED_SUN
description: Flag used with llGetRegionFlags to check if the sun's position is fixed in the region.

name: REGION_FLAG_RESTRICT_PUSHOBJECT
description: Flag used with llGetRegionFlags to check if llPushObject is restricted in the region.

name: REGION_FLAG_SANDBOX
description: Flag used with llGetRegionFlags to check if the region is designated as a sandbox.

name: REQUIRE_LINE_OF_SIGHT
description: Option flag for llPursue defining whether the character requires a physical line-of-sight to chase the target. When active, it will not target positions blocked by solid obstacles.

name: RESTITUTION
description: Used with llSetPhysicsMaterial to enable the restitution (bounciness) value (must be between 0.0 and 1.0) which overrides the previous value.

name: REVERSE
description: Used with texture animation functions to cause the animation to play in reverse (from end to start).

name: REZ_ACCEL
description: Rez parameter specifying a constant acceleration force to apply to the rezzed object (as a [vector force, integer relative] pair). If relative is TRUE, the vector is in local coordinates.

name: REZ_DAMAGE
description: Rez parameter specifying the float damage amount the rezzed object inflicts on an agent upon collision.

name: REZ_DAMAGE_TYPE
description: Rez parameter specifying the integer damage type applied on collision (supports DAMAGE_TYPE_* constants, custom types, or a repurposed damage field).

name: REZ_FLAGS
description: Rez parameter specifying the integer bitfield of flags to apply to the newly created object.

name: REZ_FLAG_BLOCK_GRAB_OBJECT
description: Rez flag that disables grabbing on the newly rezzed object.

name: REZ_FLAG_DIE_ON_COLLIDE
description: Rez flag causing the object to die/delete after its first collision.

name: REZ_FLAG_DIE_ON_NOENTRY
description: Rez flag causing the object to die/delete if it attempts to enter an unauthorized parcel.

name: REZ_FLAG_DIE_ON_NO_REZZER
description: Rez flag causing the object to die if the rezzing object or agent is not present.

name: REZ_FLAG_NO_COLLIDE_FAMILY
description: Rez flag preventing collision events from triggering when colliding with other objects created by the same rezzer.

name: REZ_FLAG_NO_COLLIDE_OWNER
description: Rez flag preventing collision events from triggering when colliding with its owner.

name: REZ_FLAG_PHANTOM
description: Rez flag causing the object to be created as phantom.

name: REZ_FLAG_PHYSICAL
description: Rez flag causing the object to be created with physics enabled.

name: REZ_FLAG_TEMP
description: Rez flag causing the object to be created as temporary.

name: REZ_LOCK_AXES
description: Rez parameter [vector locks] used to prevent the physical object from rotating or spinning around specified axes. Setting a coordinate to a non-zero value locks that axis.

name: REZ_OMEGA
description: Rez parameter specifying the initial angular velocity (omega) applied to the object. Accepts [vector axis, integer relative, float spin, float gain]. If relative is TRUE, the axis vector is in local coordinates.

name: REZ_PARAM
description: Rez parameter specifying the integer start parameter passed into the newly rezzed object's on_rez event.

name: REZ_PARAM_STRING
description: Rez parameter specifying an initialization string (up to 1024 bytes) passed to the root prim of the newly rezzed object, readable via llGetStartString.

name: REZ_POS
description: Rez parameter [vector position, integer relative, integer at_root] to specify where to rez the object. Can be in region coordinates or relative to the rezzing object, and centered on either the object's center or the root prim.

name: REZ_ROT
description: Rez parameter specifying the initial rotation to apply to the newly rezzed object. Can be relative to the rezzing object or absolute.

name: REZ_SOUND
description: Rez parameter [string name_or_uuid, float volume, integer loop] to attach and play a sound from inventory or a UUID asset key. If loop is TRUE, it loops continuously.

name: REZ_SOUND_COLLIDE
description: Rez parameter [string name_or_uuid, float volume] specifying a sound (from inventory or a UUID asset key) to play upon collision with another object, the ground, or an avatar.

name: REZ_VEL
description: Rez parameter specifying the initial velocity to apply to the object. Accepts [vector velocity, integer local, integer inherit]. If inherit is TRUE, it adds the rezzing object's velocity.

name: ROTATE
description: Used with texture animation functions to animate the texture's rotation. Cannot be combined with SCALE.

name: SCALE
description: Used with texture animation functions to animate the texture's scale. Cannot be combined with ROTATE.

name: SCRIPTED
description: Identifies scripted in-world objects. In llDetectedType(), indicates the target has at least one active script. In llSensor()/llSensorRepeat() filters, searches for objects containing active scripts that are currently running.

name: SIM_STAT_ACTIVE_SCRIPT_COUNT
description: Returns the total number of active scripts in the region.

name: SIM_STAT_AGENT_COUNT
description: Returns the total number of agents in the region.

name: SIM_STAT_AGENT_MS
description: Returns the time spent in the 'agent' segment of the simulation frame.

name: SIM_STAT_AGENT_UPDATES
description: Returns the number of agent updates per second.

name: SIM_STAT_AI_MS
description: Returns the time spent on the AI step.

name: SIM_STAT_ASSET_DOWNLOADS
description: Returns the pending asset download count.

name: SIM_STAT_ASSET_UPLOADS
description: Returns the pending asset upload count.

name: SIM_STAT_CHILD_AGENT_COUNT
description: Returns the number of child (neighboring) agents in the region.

name: SIM_STAT_FRAME_MS
description: Returns the total frame time.

name: SIM_STAT_IMAGE_MS
description: Returns the time spent in the 'image' segment of the simulation frame.

name: SIM_STAT_IO_PUMP_MS
description: Returns the pump IO time.

name: SIM_STAT_NET_MS
description: Returns the time spent in the 'network' segment of the simulation frame.

name: SIM_STAT_OTHER_MS
description: Returns the time spent in the main simulation 'other' segment of the frame, which encapsulates task, script, and miscellaneous updates.

name: SIM_STAT_PACKETS_IN
description: Returns the average number of incoming packets per second.

name: SIM_STAT_PACKETS_OUT
description: Returns the average number of outgoing packets per second.

name: SIM_STAT_PCT_CHARS_STEPPED
description: Returns the percentage of pathfinding characters updated (or skipped) each frame, averaged over the last minute. Corresponds to the 'Characters Updated' stat in the viewer's Statistics Bar.

name: SIM_STAT_PHYSICS_FPS
description: Returns the physics simulation frames per second (FPS).

name: SIM_STAT_PHYSICS_MS
description: Returns the time spent in the 'physics' segment of the simulation frame.

name: SIM_STAT_PHYSICS_OTHER_MS
description: Returns the average update time for the physics 'other' segment.

name: SIM_STAT_PHYSICS_SHAPE_MS
description: Returns the average update time for the physics 'shape' segment.

name: SIM_STAT_PHYSICS_STEP_MS
description: Returns the average physics step time.

name: SIM_STAT_SCRIPT_EPS
description: Returns the number of script events per second.

name: SIM_STAT_SCRIPT_MS
description: Returns the time spent in the 'script' segment of the simulation frame.

name: SIM_STAT_SCRIPT_RUN_PCT
description: Returns the percentage of scripts run during the frame.

name: SIM_STAT_SLEEP_MS
description: Returns the time spent sleeping.

name: SIM_STAT_SPARE_MS
description: Returns the spare time left after the frame.

name: SIM_STAT_UNACKED_BYTES
description: Returns the total number of unacknowledged bytes.

name: SIT_FLAG_ALLOW_UNSIT
description: Sit flag indicating that a seated avatar is allowed to manually stand up (unsit) from a sit target. Applies only to agents who were seated via an LSL script like llSitOnLink.

name: SIT_FLAG_NO_COLLIDE
description: Sit flag that disables the avatar's collision volume/hitbox while seated on this sit target.

name: SIT_FLAG_NO_DAMAGE
description: Sit flag that prevents damage from being distributed or forwarded to agents sitting on this sit target.

name: SIT_FLAG_SCRIPTED_ONLY
description: Sit flag that restricts sits to script-controlled actions only, preventing avatars from manually sitting on this prim.

name: SIT_FLAG_SIT_TARGET
description: Read-only sit flag indicating whether the prim has an active sit target. Set or cleared using llSitTarget, llLinkSitTarget, or PRIM_SIT_TARGET, and read via llGetLinkSitFlags or PRIM_SIT_FLAGS.

name: SIT_INVALID_AGENT
description: Sit error code indicating that the specified agent/avatar ID could not be found or is invalid.

name: SIT_INVALID_LINK
description: Sit error code indicating that the link ID does not specify a valid prim, is not found, or resolves to multiple prims.

name: SIT_INVALID_OBJECT
description: Sit error code returned when attempting to force an avatar to sit on an invalid target (such as an attachment) that cannot be sat upon.

name: SIT_NOT_EXPERIENCE
description: Sit error code returned if the script is not running within a valid experience, lacks a valid experience key, or the experience is not permitted at the current location.

name: SIT_NO_ACCESS
description: Sit error code indicating that the avatar lacks access to the parcel where the target prim/linkset is located.

name: SIT_NO_EXPERIENCE_PERMISSION
description: Sit error code indicating that the agent has not granted experience permissions to force sits.

name: SIT_NO_SIT_TARGET
description: Sit error code indicating that no open or available sit target could be found in the linkset.

name: SIT_OK
description: Sit error code indicating that the agent was seated successfully.

name: SKY_AMBIENT
description: Environmental setting for the ambient color used in the scene.

name: SKY_BLUE
description: Environmental setting containing the colors used to calculate blue density and blue horizon in the sky.

name: SKY_CLOUDS
description: Environmental cloud parameters including color, coverage percentage, scale, variance, scroll speed (X/Y), density, detail exponents, and default texture status.

name: SKY_CLOUD_TEXTURE
description: Environmental setting containing the inventory name or UUID of the texture used for the clouds.

name: SKY_DENSITY_PROFILE_COUNTS
description: Environmental setting representing counts for each density profile type.

name: SKY_DOME
description: Environmental setting containing sky dome parameters: offset, radius, and maximum altitude.

name: SKY_GAMMA
description: Environmental setting for the gamma value applied to the scene (repurposed in viewer 7.0+ as the HDR Scale value in the EEP editor).

name: SKY_GLOW
description: Environmental setting for sun and moon glow parameters: size and focus.

name: SKY_HAZE
description: Environmental setting containing the values used to calculate the light scattering impact of blue density and blue horizon on the scene.

name: SKY_LIGHT
description: Environmental setting containing lighting parameters: dominant light direction (unit vector), current light color (fade_color in sRGB), and total ambient color (sRGB).

name: SKY_MIE_CONFIG
description: Environmental setting for Mie scattering profile parameters.

name: SKY_MOON
description: Environmental moon parameters: rotation, scale, brightness, is_default_texture, direction vector, ambient color, and diffuse color.

name: SKY_MOON_TEXTURE
description: Environmental setting containing the inventory name or UUID of the texture used for the moon.

name: SKY_PLANET
description: Environmental planet rendering parameters: planet_radius, sky_bottom_radius, and sky_top_radius.

name: SKY_RAYLEIGH_CONFIG
description: Environmental setting for Rayleigh scattering profile parameters.

name: SKY_REFLECTION_PROBE_AMBIANCE
description: Environmental setting for the minimum ambiance value of all reflection probes. Note: Supported in the GLTF Materials project, requiring compatible viewers and testing areas.

name: SKY_REFRACTION
description: Environmental sky refraction parameters for rainbows and optical effects: moisture_level, droplet_radius, and ice_level.

name: SKY_STAR_BRIGHTNESS
description: Environmental setting for the brightness value applied to stars.

name: SKY_SUN
description: Environmental sun parameters: rotation, scale, color, is_default_texture, direction vector, ambient color, and diffuse color.

name: SKY_SUN_TEXTURE
description: Environmental setting containing the inventory name or UUID of the texture used for the sun.

name: SKY_TEXTURE_DEFAULTS
description: Environmental check returning 1 if the sky textures are set to their default values, or 0 if they use custom textures.

name: SKY_TRACKS
description: Environmental setting containing the track altitudes used for sky transitions in the region.

name: SMOOTH
description: Used with texture animation functions to cause the animation to slide smoothly in the X direction (or transition smoothly in SCALE/ROTATE modes) instead of making instant frame changes.

name: SOUND_LOOP
description: Sound playback option that loops the sound continuously on the prim until stopped.

name: SOUND_PLAY
description: Sound playback option (default) that plays the sound once, attached to the prim.

name: SOUND_SYNC
description: Sound playback option that synchronizes playback to the nearest active sound master (see llLoopSoundMaster).

name: SOUND_TRIGGER
description: Sound playback option that triggers a non-attached sound once at the prim's current location (does not move with the prim). This flag overrides all other sound playback options.

name: SQRT2
description: Mathematical constant representing the square root of 2.

name: STATUS_BLOCK_GRAB
description: Status flag (default FALSE) that blocks click-and-drag grab movements on unlinked prims or the root prim of a linkset. Useful for preventing physical objects from being trivially disturbed.

name: STATUS_BLOCK_GRAB_OBJECT
description: Status flag that blocks click-and-drag grab movements on all prims across the entire linkset.

name: STATUS_BOUNDS_ERROR
description: Status code indicating that one or more arguments passed to the function had a bounds error.

name: STATUS_CAST_SHADOWS
description: Unused legacy status flag intended to configure an object's ability to cast shadows.

name: STATUS_DIE_AT_EDGE
description: Status flag (default TRUE) that causes the object to be deleted (and not returned) if it goes off-world (useful for bullets or rockets). Overridden by STATUS_RETURN_AT_EDGE.

name: STATUS_DIE_AT_NO_ENTRY
description: Status flag (default FALSE) that causes the object to be deleted if it attempts to enter an unauthorized or full parcel. No-copy objects ignore this setting and remain in-world.

name: STATUS_DIE_ON_NO_REZZER
description: Status flag (default FALSE) that causes the object to be deleted if the rezzing object or agent is not present.

name: STATUS_INTERNAL_ERROR
description: Status code indicating an internal error occurred.

name: STATUS_MALFORMED_PARAMS
description: Status code indicating the function was called with malformed parameters.

name: STATUS_NOT_FOUND
description: Status code indicating that the specified object or item was not found.

name: STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED
description: Status code indicating the requested feature is not supported.

name: STATUS_OK
description: Status code indicating the function call completed successfully.

name: STATUS_PHANTOM
description: Status flag (default FALSE) that makes the entire object phantom/non-colliding when set to TRUE, allowing avatars and objects to pass through it. It is a good idea to use this for most objects that move or rotate, but are non-physical. It is also useful for simulating volumetric lighting.

name: STATUS_PHYSICS
description: Status flag (default FALSE) that controls whether the object responds to physical interactions, gravity, and forces.

name: STATUS_RETURN_AT_EDGE
description: Status flag causing the object to be returned to its owner when it goes off-world, overriding STATUS_DIE_AT_EDGE.

name: STATUS_ROTATE_X
description: Status flag (default TRUE) that allows physical rotation on the object's local X-axis. Setting to FALSE prevents physical rotation around the local X-axis. For example, a sit-and-spin device spins around the Z axis (up) but not around the X or Y axes.

name: STATUS_ROTATE_Y
description: Status flag (default TRUE) that allows physical rotation on the object's local Y-axis. Setting to FALSE prevents physical rotation around the local Y-axis. For example, a sit-and-spin device spins around the Z axis (up) but not around the X or Y axes.

name: STATUS_ROTATE_Z
description: Status flag (default TRUE) that allows physical rotation on the object's local Z-axis. Setting to FALSE prevents physical rotation around the local Z-axis.

name: STATUS_SANDBOX
description: Status flag (default FALSE) that restricts the object's physical movement to within its creation region and a short distance (10 to 20 meters) from its creation point to prevent it from escaping.

name: STATUS_TYPE_MISMATCH
description: Status code indicating that one or more arguments passed to the function had a type mismatch.

name: STATUS_WHITELIST_FAILED
description: Status code indicating a media domain whitelist check has failed.

name: STRING_TRIM
description: Trims whitespace off both the beginning and the end of the string.

name: STRING_TRIM_HEAD
description: Trims whitespace/spaces off the beginning of the string.

name: STRING_TRIM_TAIL
description: Trims whitespace/spaces off the end of the string.

name: TARGETED_EMAIL_OBJECT_OWNER
description: Flag used with llTargetedEmail to send the email message to the owner of the calling object.

name: TARGETED_EMAIL_ROOT_CREATOR
description: Flag used with llTargetedEmail to send the email message to the creator of the root object.

name: TERRAIN_DETAIL_1
description: Terrain parameter used with llSetGroundTexture to set the texture or material (via UUID, inventory name, or default NULL_KEY/empty string) for terrain detail layer 1.

name: TERRAIN_DETAIL_2
description: Terrain parameter used with llSetGroundTexture to set the texture or material (via UUID, inventory name, or default NULL_KEY/empty string) for terrain detail layer 2.

name: TERRAIN_DETAIL_3
description: Terrain parameter used with llSetGroundTexture to set the texture or material (via UUID, inventory name, or default NULL_KEY/empty string) for terrain detail layer 3.

name: TERRAIN_DETAIL_4
description: Terrain parameter used with llSetGroundTexture to set the texture or material (via UUID, inventory name, or default NULL_KEY/empty string) for terrain detail layer 4.

name: TERRAIN_HEIGHT_RANGE_NE
description: Terrain parameter used with llSetGroundTexture to set the north-east height range for texture blending. Specifies low as the maximum height for texture 1, high as the minimum height for texture 4, and lets textures 2 and 3 mix in between.

name: TERRAIN_HEIGHT_RANGE_NW
description: Terrain parameter used with llSetGroundTexture to set the north-west height range for texture blending. Specifies low as the maximum height for texture 1, high as the minimum height for texture 4, and lets textures 2 and 3 mix in between.

name: TERRAIN_HEIGHT_RANGE_SE
description: Terrain parameter used with llSetGroundTexture to set the south-east height range for texture blending. Specifies low as the maximum height for texture 1, high as the minimum height for texture 4, and lets textures 2 and 3 mix in between.

name: TERRAIN_HEIGHT_RANGE_SW
description: Terrain parameter used with llSetGroundTexture to set the south-west height range for texture blending. Specifies low as the maximum height for texture 1, high as the minimum height for texture 4, and lets textures 2 and 3 mix in between.

name: TERRAIN_PBR_OFFSET_1
description: Terrain parameter used with llSetGroundTexture to set the UV offset vector (ignoring the Z component) for drawing terrain layer 1. Only works for PBR textures.

name: TERRAIN_PBR_OFFSET_2
description: Terrain parameter used with llSetGroundTexture to set the UV offset vector (ignoring the Z component) for drawing terrain layer 2. Only works for PBR textures.

name: TERRAIN_PBR_OFFSET_3
description: Terrain parameter used with llSetGroundTexture to set the UV offset vector (ignoring the Z component) for drawing terrain layer 3. Only works for PBR textures.

name: TERRAIN_PBR_OFFSET_4
description: Terrain parameter used with llSetGroundTexture to set the UV offset vector (ignoring the Z component) for drawing terrain layer 4. Only works for PBR textures.

name: TERRAIN_PBR_ROTATION_1
description: Terrain parameter used with llSetGroundTexture to set the rotation of the PBR texture for layer 1, in radians. Only works for PBR textures.

name: TERRAIN_PBR_ROTATION_2
description: Terrain parameter used with llSetGroundTexture to set the rotation of the PBR texture for layer 2, in radians. Only works for PBR textures.

name: TERRAIN_PBR_ROTATION_3
description: Terrain parameter used with llSetGroundTexture to set the rotation of the PBR texture for layer 3, in radians. Only works for PBR textures.

name: TERRAIN_PBR_ROTATION_4
description: Terrain parameter used with llSetGroundTexture to set the rotation of the PBR texture for layer 4, in radians. Only works for PBR textures.

name: TERRAIN_PBR_SCALE_1
description: Terrain parameter used with llSetGroundTexture to set the UV scale vector (repeats per meter, ignoring the Z component) for terrain layer 1. Only works for PBR textures.

name: TERRAIN_PBR_SCALE_2
description: Terrain parameter used with llSetGroundTexture to set the UV scale vector (repeats per meter, ignoring the Z component) for terrain layer 2. Only works for PBR textures.

name: TERRAIN_PBR_SCALE_3
description: Terrain parameter used with llSetGroundTexture to set the UV scale vector (repeats per meter, ignoring the Z component) for terrain layer 3. Only works for PBR textures.

name: TERRAIN_PBR_SCALE_4
description: Terrain parameter used with llSetGroundTexture to set the UV scale vector (repeats per meter, ignoring the Z component) for terrain layer 4. Only works for PBR textures.

name: TEXTURE_BLANK
description: Asset UUID representing the default 'Blank' texture.

name: TEXTURE_MEDIA
description: Asset UUID representing the default 'Default Media' texture.

name: TEXTURE_PLYWOOD
description: Asset UUID representing the default 'Plywood' texture.

name: TEXTURE_TRANSPARENT
description: Asset UUID representing the '*Default Transparent Texture' in the library (included with viewers).

name: TOUCH_INVALID_FACE
description: Value returned by llDetectedTouchFace when the touch position is not valid.

name: TOUCH_INVALID_TEXCOORD
description: Value returned by llDetectedTouchUV and llDetectedTouchST when the touch position is not valid.

name: TOUCH_INVALID_VECTOR
description: Value returned by llDetectedTouchPos, llDetectedTouchNormal, and llDetectedTouchBinormal when the touch position is not valid.

name: TP_ROUTING_BLOCKED
description: Teleport routing setting indicating that direct teleporting is blocked on the parcel.

name: TP_ROUTING_FREE
description: Teleport routing setting indicating that teleports are unrestricted on the parcel.

name: TP_ROUTING_LANDINGP
description: Teleport routing setting indicating that teleports are routed to the parcel's landing point (if one has been set).

name: TRANSFER_BAD_OPTS
description: Inventory transfer error code indicating that an invalid option was passed in the options list.

name: TRANSFER_BAD_ROOT
description: Inventory transfer error code indicating that the root path specified in TRANSFER_DEST was invalid or resolved to nothing.

name: TRANSFER_DEST
description: Inventory option specifying the destination root folder to transfer inventory into.

name: TRANSFER_FLAGS
description: Inventory parameter specifying flags to control the behavior of inventory transfers.

name: TRANSFER_FLAG_COPY
description: Inventory transfer flag that copies the transferred object and places it in the recipient's inventory (implies TRANSFER_FLAG_TAKE).

name: TRANSFER_FLAG_RESERVED
description: Inventory transfer flag reserved for future expansion; do not use.

name: TRANSFER_FLAG_TAKE
description: Inventory transfer flag that automatically removes the object from the world and places it in the recipient's inventory once accepted.

name: TRANSFER_NO_ATTACHMENT
description: Inventory transfer error code indicating ownership of an attached object cannot be transferred.

name: TRANSFER_NO_ITEMS
description: Inventory transfer error code indicating that the list was empty or contained only non-transferable items.

name: TRANSFER_NO_PERMS
description: Inventory transfer error code indicating the object lacks transfer permissions.

name: TRANSFER_NO_TARGET
description: Inventory transfer error code indicating the receiving agent could not be found in the current region.

name: TRANSFER_OK
description: Status code indicating that the inventory transfer was successful or the transfer offer was successfully made.

name: TRANSFER_THROTTLE
description: Inventory transfer error code indicating that the transfer rate has exceeded the inventory transfer throttle.

name: TRAVERSAL_TYPE
description: Pathfinding parameter specifying the character's movement traversal type. Expects TRAVERSAL_TYPE_SLOW (default), _FAST, or _NONE.

name: TRUE
description: Mnemonic constant representing a boolean TRUE value (integer 1). Used in conditional structures or variables to improve script readability.

name: TWO_PI
description: Mathematical constant pi*2, representing the number of radians in a full circle.

name: TYPE_FLOAT
description: Variable type constant indicating the list entry or value is a float.

name: TYPE_INTEGER
description: Variable type constant indicating the list entry or value is an integer.

name: TYPE_INVALID
description: Variable type constant indicating the list entry or value is invalid.

name: TYPE_KEY
description: Variable type constant indicating the list entry or value is a key.

name: TYPE_ROTATION
description: Variable type constant indicating the list entry or value is a rotation.

name: TYPE_STRING
description: Variable type constant indicating the list entry or value is a string.

name: TYPE_VECTOR
description: Variable type constant indicating the list entry or value is a vector.

name: VEHICLE_ANGULAR_DEFLECTION_EFFICIENCY
description: Vehicle float parameter (range 0.0 to 1.0) acting as a scalar to modulate the strength of angular deflection, reorienting the vehicle's preferred axis toward its true velocity.

name: VEHICLE_ANGULAR_DEFLECTION_TIMESCALE
description: Vehicle float parameter specifying the exponential timescale for the vehicle to achieve full angular deflection, reorienting its preferred axis of motion to match its true velocity.

name: VEHICLE_ANGULAR_FRICTION_TIMESCALE
description: Vehicle vector parameter specifying the timescales (range [0.07, infinity) seconds per axis) for the exponential decay of angular velocity about the vehicle's preferred axes (at, left, up).

name: VEHICLE_ANGULAR_MOTOR_DECAY_TIMESCALE
description: Vehicle float parameter specifying the exponential timescale (in seconds) for the angular motor's magnitude and effectiveness to decay toward zero.

name: VEHICLE_ANGULAR_MOTOR_DIRECTION
description: Vehicle vector parameter specifying the direction and magnitude of the angular velocity (in radians per second) that the vehicle's angular motor attempts to achieve.

name: VEHICLE_ANGULAR_MOTOR_TIMESCALE
description: Vehicle float parameter specifying the exponential timescale for the vehicle's angular motor to achieve full power and velocity.

name: VEHICLE_BANKING_EFFICIENCY
description: Vehicle float parameter (range -1.0 to 1.0) controlling banking efficiency, where negative values lean out of turns and positive values lean into turns. This parameter makes banking affect steering; use angular motors to bank. 0.0 means no banking.

name: VEHICLE_BANKING_MIX
description: Vehicle float parameter (range 0.0 (static) to 1.0) (dynamic) controlling the mix between static banking (scales only with roll angle) and dynamic banking (additionally scales with linear speed).

name: VEHICLE_BANKING_TIMESCALE
description: Vehicle float parameter specifying the exponential timescale for the banking behavior to take full effect. This is another way to scale the strength of the banking effect, however it affects the term that is proportional to the difference between what the banking behavior is trying to do, and what the vehicle is actually doing.

name: VEHICLE_BUOYANCY
description: Vehicle float parameter (range -1.0 to 1.0) defining buoyancy, where -1.0 represents double gravity and 1.0 represents full anti-gravity.

name: VEHICLE_FLAG_BLOCK_INTERFERENCE
description: Vehicle flag that prevents attachments worn by passengers from pushing the vehicle via llPushObject or other scripting functions.

name: VEHICLE_FLAG_CAMERA_DECOUPLED
description: Vehicle flag used with mouselook steering/banking. When set, the passenger's mouselook camera rotates independently of the vehicle's orientation.

name: VEHICLE_FLAG_HOVER_GLOBAL_HEIGHT
description: Vehicle flag that forces the hover behavior to maintain a global height rather than hovering relative to the ground or water.

name: VEHICLE_FLAG_HOVER_TERRAIN_ONLY
description: Vehicle flag that forces the hover behavior to ignore water height and hover exclusively relative to the terrain/land.

name: VEHICLE_FLAG_HOVER_UP_ONLY
description: Vehicle flag preventing hover from pushing downward, allowing hovering vehicles to jump or fly above their designated hover height.

name: VEHICLE_FLAG_HOVER_WATER_ONLY
description: Vehicle flag that forces the hover behavior to ignore terrain height and hover exclusively relative to water.

name: VEHICLE_FLAG_LIMIT_MOTOR_UP
description: Vehicle flag that prevents ground vehicles from motoring upward into the sky. When combined with banking, banking strength decays when the vehicle is airborne (no longer colliding) to prevent steering mid-jump.

name: VEHICLE_FLAG_LIMIT_ROLL_ONLY
description: Vehicle flag for vehicles with a vertical attractor that need to climb or dive, allowing airplanes to use the banking feature.

name: VEHICLE_FLAG_MOUSELOOK_BANK
description: Vehicle flag that enables mouselook control, remapping left-right camera motions (yaw) to rotations about the vehicle's local X-axis.

name: VEHICLE_FLAG_MOUSELOOK_STEER
description: Vehicle flag that enables steering via mouse, directing the angular motor to align the vehicle's local X-axis with the direction of the client-side camera.

name: VEHICLE_FLAG_NO_DEFLECTION_UP
description: Vehicle flag that prevents linear deflection parallel to the world Z-axis, preventing ground vehicles (such as bumper cars) from climbing into the sky.

name: VEHICLE_FLAG_NO_FLY_UP
description: Obsolete legacy name for VEHICLE_FLAG_NO_DEFLECTION_UP.

name: VEHICLE_HOVER_EFFICIENCY
description: Vehicle float parameter (range 0.0 to 1.0) controlling hover damping, where 0.0 is bouncy and 1.0 is critically damped.

name: VEHICLE_HOVER_HEIGHT
description: Vehicle float parameter specifying the height at which the vehicle attempts to hover. Set to 0.0 to disable hover.

name: VEHICLE_HOVER_TIMESCALE
description: Vehicle float parameter specifying the timescale (period of time in seconds) for the vehicle to achieve its hover height.

name: VEHICLE_LINEAR_DEFLECTION_EFFICIENCY
description: Vehicle float parameter (range 0.0 to 1.0) modulating the efficiency and strength of linear deflection. That is, its a simple scalar for modulating the strength of linear deflection.

name: VEHICLE_LINEAR_DEFLECTION_TIMESCALE
description: Vehicle float parameter specifying the exponential timescale for the vehicle to redirect its linear velocity along its preferred X-axis. It is another way to specify how much time it takes for the vehicle's linear velocity to be redirected to its preferred axis of motion.

name: VEHICLE_LINEAR_FRICTION_TIMESCALE
description: Vehicle vector parameter specifying the timescales (range [0.07, infinity) seconds per axis) for the exponential decay of linear velocity along the vehicle's preferred axes (at, left, up).

name: VEHICLE_LINEAR_MOTOR_DECAY_TIMESCALE
description: Vehicle float parameter specifying the exponential timescale (in seconds) for the linear motor's magnitude and effectiveness to decay toward zero.

name: VEHICLE_LINEAR_MOTOR_DIRECTION
description: Vehicle vector parameter specifying the direction and magnitude of the linear velocity (range [0, 30] m/s) that the vehicle's linear motor attempts to achieve.

name: VEHICLE_LINEAR_MOTOR_OFFSET
description: Vehicle vector parameter specifying the offset from the vehicle's center of mass where the linear motor force is applied.

name: VEHICLE_LINEAR_MOTOR_TIMESCALE
description: Vehicle float parameter specifying the exponential timescale for the vehicle to reach its full linear motor velocity.

name: VEHICLE_REFERENCE_FRAME
description: Vehicle rotation parameter setting the orientation of the vehicle's preferred axes of motion (at, left, up) relative to its local geometric frame (x, y, z).

name: VEHICLE_TYPE_AIRPLANE
description: Vehicle type constant for aircraft that use linear deflection for lift, banking to turn, and no hover.

name: VEHICLE_TYPE_BALLOON
description: Vehicle type constant for balloons that use hover and friction but no deflection.

name: VEHICLE_TYPE_BOAT
description: Vehicle type constant for boats that hover over water with high friction and minor angular deflection.

name: VEHICLE_TYPE_CAR
description: Vehicle type constant for land vehicles that bounce along the ground and rely on external controls or timer events to drive their motors.

name: VEHICLE_TYPE_NONE
description: Constant used to disable and turn off vehicle physics support on the object.

name: VEHICLE_TYPE_SLED
description: Vehicle type constant for sliding vehicles that bump along the ground and prefer to move along their local X-axis.

name: VEHICLE_VERTICAL_ATTRACTION_EFFICIENCY
description: Vehicle float parameter (range 0.0 to 1.0) controlling vertical attraction stability (0.0 is wobbly/bouncy, 1.0 is critically damped/firm) to keep the vehicle upright.

name: VEHICLE_VERTICAL_ATTRACTION_TIMESCALE
description: Vehicle float parameter specifying the exponential timescale (in seconds) for the vehicle to rotate and align its local Z-axis (up) with the world Z-axis (vertical).

name: VERTICAL
description: Constant indicating that the collision capsule orientation for a pathfinding character is vertical.

name: WANDER_PAUSE_AT_WAYPOINTS
description: Option parameter for llWanderWithin specifying whether the character should pause briefly after reaching each wander waypoint.

name: WATER_BLUR_MULTIPLIER
description: Environmental setting specifying the multiplier applied to blur the scene when underwater.

name: WATER_FOG
description: Environmental underwater fog parameters: color, density exponent, and modulation.

name: WATER_FRESNEL
description: Environmental water surface Fresnel scattering parameters: offset and scale.

name: WATER_NORMAL_SCALE
description: Environmental setting specifying the scaling vector applied to the water normal map.

name: WATER_NORMAL_TEXTURE
description: Environmental setting containing the inventory name or UUID of the normal map texture used for water waves.

name: WATER_REFRACTION
description: Environmental water surface refraction scale factors: scale_above and scale_below.

name: WATER_TEXTURE_DEFAULTS
description: Environmental check returning 1 if default water wave maps are used, or 0 if a custom texture is set.

name: WATER_WAVE_DIRECTION
description: Environmental wave direction vectors (X is east/west, Y is north/south) specifying speeds and directions for both large and small waves.

name: XP_ERROR_EXPERIENCES_DISABLED
description: Region currently has experiences disabled.

name: XP_ERROR_EXPERIENCE_DISABLED
description: Experience owner has temporarily disabled the experience.

name: XP_ERROR_EXPERIENCE_SUSPENDED
description: Experience has been suspended by Linden Lab customer support.

name: XP_ERROR_INVALID_EXPERIENCE
description: Script is associated with an experience that no longer exists.

name: XP_ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETERS
description: One of the string arguments was too big to fit in the key-value store.

name: XP_ERROR_KEY_NOT_FOUND
description: Requested key does not exist.

name: XP_ERROR_MATURITY_EXCEEDED
description: Content rating of the experience exceeds that of the region.

name: XP_ERROR_NONE
description: No error was detected.

name: XP_ERROR_NOT_FOUND
description: Sim was unable to verify the validity of the experience. Retrying after a short wait is advised.

name: XP_ERROR_NOT_PERMITTED
description: This experience is not allowed to run by the requested agent, or experience permissions were denied by the user.

name: XP_ERROR_NOT_PERMITTED_LAND
description: Experience is blocked or not enabled for this land, or is not allowed to run in the current region.

name: XP_ERROR_NO_EXPERIENCE

name: ZERO_ROTATION

description: A vector constant representing <0.0, 0.0, 0.0>. This is the default value for vector variables.
